title.en: Nepal bet nearly everything on hydropower - the floods show why that's a problem
title.zh: 尼泊尔几乎押注一切在水力发电——洪水显示了为什么这是一个问题

summary.en: Nepal's energy generation capacity was significantly impacted by recent floods, with over 10% of its total power generation knocked out. The nation heavily relies on hydropower, which is vulnerable to climate change effects like glacial melt and extreme weather events.
summary.zh: 尼泊尔最近的洪水严重影响了其发电能力，超过10%的总发电量被摧毁。该国严重依赖水力发电，而水力发电容易受到全球变暖的影响，如冰川融化和极端天气事件。

body.en:
Almost 100% of Nepal's electricity comes from hydropower, and it produces so much it earns nearly $200m (£147m) each year exporting hydroelectricity to India and Bangladesh.

But the very glaciers and mountains giving Nepal this massive natural advantage are succumbing to global warming - and last Wednesday's deadly floods have laid bare the risks to the nation's hydropower ambitions.

The floods, which destroyed entire villages near the border of Nepal and Tibet, severely damaged 12 hydropower plants in the Trishuli River basin and knocked out more than 10% of Nepal's total power generation capacity. Operators tell the BBC they don't yet know if any of these facilities can be brought back to operation.

The state-owned Nepal Electricity Authority, which owns six of the 12 damaged facilities, has assured Nepalese households that supply remains adequate. But its spokesman Rajan Dhakal acknowledges that with climate-related disasters becoming more frequent, "the time has come for a rethink of our hydropower policy".

Only two-thirds of people in Nepal had access to electricity in 2010, and even connected households would face power cuts for up to 16 hours a day.

An expansion of hydropower infrastructure alongside efforts to tackle corruption and boost energy imports from India to fill seasonal gaps meant that by 2018, most of Nepal was enjoying 24 hours of power supply per day.

At present, there are 225 hydropower plants across Nepal with more than 3,900MW of installed capacity, according to the Nepal Electricity Authority - capable of powering some three million households simultaneously.

Hundreds more such facilities are either being constructed or in the pipeline. Most of them are built high up in the mountains, where they can seize fast-flowing currents to generate power. These projects require little to no storage system.

However, with the high-altitude regions of the Himalayas warming 50% faster than the global average, they face greater environmental risks. Preliminary investigations have pointed to a collapsed glacier and its bedrock as the cause of last week's flash flood.

While scientists say it is too soon to draw any firm links to climate change, Nepal's Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Authority previously said more than nine in 10 disaster events recorded between 2018 and 2024 were "related to climate".

Nepal's former Energy Minister Kulman Ghising, who called the catastrophic deluge a "once-in-a-century" event, says it holds lessons for designing plants and picking sites where they are built.

"We need to design the plants [to be more] resilient to the floods and, most importantly, adopt early-warning systems as well as robust emergency evacuation measures," he told environmental news outlet Mongabay.

body.zh: 尼泊尔几乎 100% 的电力来自水力发电，该国每年通过向印度和孟加拉国出口水力发电赚取近 2 亿美元（1.47 亿英镑）的收入。 但赋予尼泊尔巨大自然优势的冰川和山脉正在因全球变暖而消失，而上周三致命的洪水暴露了该国水电雄心面临的风险。 洪水摧毁了尼泊尔和西藏边境附近的整个村庄，严重损坏了特里舒里河流域的12座水电站，摧毁了尼泊尔总发电量的10%以上。运营商告诉英国广播公司，他们还不知道这些设施是否可以恢复运营。 尼泊尔国有电力局拥有 12 个受损设施中的 6 个，该局已向尼泊尔家庭保证供电仍然充足。但其发言人拉詹·达卡尔承认，随着与气候有关的灾害变得越来越频繁，“现在是重新考虑我们的水电政策的时候了”。 2010年，尼泊尔只有三分之二的人用上了电，即使是联网的家庭也会面临每天长达16小时的断电。 水电基础设施的扩建，加上反腐败和增加从印度进口能源以填补季节性缺口的努力，意味着到 2018 年，尼泊尔大部分地区将享受每天 24 小时的电力供应。 据尼泊尔电力局称，目前尼泊尔全国有225座水电站，装机容量超过3900兆瓦，能够同时为约300万户家庭供电。 还有数百个此类设施正在建设或正在建设中。它们大多建在高山上，可以利用湍急的水流来发电。这些项目几乎不需要存储系统。 然而，喜马拉雅山高海拔地区的变暖速度比全球平均水平快50%，面临着更大的环境风险。初步调查表明，崩塌的冰川及其基岩是上周山洪暴发的原因。 尽管科学家表示，现在就与气候变化建立任何明确的联系还为时过早，但尼泊尔灾害风险减少和管理局此前表示，2018年至2024年期间记录的十分之九以上的灾害事件“与气候有关”。 尼泊尔前能源部长库尔曼·吉辛称这次灾难性洪水是“百年一遇”的事件，他表示，这次灾难为设计工厂和选择建造地点提供了经验教训。 他告诉环境新闻媒体 Mongabay：“我们需要将工厂设计得更能抵御洪水，最重要的是，采用预警系统以及强有力的紧急疏散措施。” 可能有数百...

reflection.en: Nepal's ambitious hydropower projects, a source of national pride and income, are now facing severe disruption due to floods exacerbated by climate change. This situation reflects the broader biblical understanding of creation itself groaning under the strain of human activity and environmental degradation. The very natural systems that provide life and...
reflection.zh: 尼泊尔雄心勃勃的水力发电项目，曾是国家骄傲和收入的来源，如今却因气候变化加剧的洪水而面临严重中断。这种情况反映了圣经中关于受造界因人类活动和环境退化而叹息的更广泛理解。提供生命和养分的自然系统本身正变得不稳定，这提醒我们与大地的相互联系以及其失衡的后果。

verse.textEn: We know that the whole creation has been groaning as in the pains of childbirth right up to the present time.
verse.textZh: 我们知道，一切受造之物一同叹息、劳苦，直到如今。

title.en: Steve Witkoff and Jared Kushner land in Moscow aiming to revive Ukraine talks
title.zh: 史蒂夫·维特科夫和贾里德·库什纳抵达莫斯科，旨在重启乌克兰会谈

summary.en: US envoys Steve Witkoff and Jared Kushner have arrived in Moscow to attempt to revive a deal to end Russia's invasion of Ukraine. They are expected to meet with Vladimir Putin before traveling to Kyiv, following recent failures in peace efforts. The visit occurs as Trump has suggested a new proposal to end the war.
summary.zh: 美国特使史蒂夫·维特科夫和贾里德·库什纳已抵达莫斯科，试图重启一项结束俄罗斯入侵乌克兰的协议。在近期和平努力失败后，他们预计将在前往基辅之前会见弗拉基米尔·普京。此次访问正值特朗普提出一项结束战争的新提议之际。

body.en: US envoys expected to meet Vladimir Putin before going to Kyiv, after peace efforts floundered in recent months The US envoys Steve Witkoff and Jared Kushner have arrived in Moscow to try to resuscitate a deal to end Russia’s invasion of Ukraine, as both sides said they would halt airstrikes for the visit. The envoys were met at the airport on Saturday by the Russian presidential envoy Kirill Dmitriev, a key interlocutor for the Trump administration’s efforts to end the Ukraine-Russia war. The US outlet Axios reported that they were expected to meet the Russian president, Vladimir Putin, later in the day. The visit came as Trump suggested on Friday a new proposal to end the war, without providing any details on what his new plan might be. Trump made ending the war a priority early in his second term, but his efforts have so far yielded little results. Continue reading...
body.zh: 在和平努力近几个月陷入困境后，美国特使预计将在前往基辅之前会见弗拉基米尔·普京。美国特使史蒂夫·威特科夫和贾里德·库什纳已抵达莫斯科，试图重启一项结束俄罗斯入侵乌克兰的协议，双方均表示将在访问期间停止空袭。周六，俄罗斯总统特使基里尔·德米特里耶夫在机场会见了特使们，他是特朗普政府结束乌俄战争努力的关键对话者。美国媒体 Axios 报道称，他们预计将于当天晚些时候会见俄罗斯总统弗拉基米尔·普京。此次访问正值特朗普周五提出结束战争的新提议之际，但没有提供任何有关他的新计划的细节。特朗普在第二任期初期就将结束战争作为优先事项，但迄今为止他的努力收效甚微。继续阅读...

reflection.en: In a world weary of conflict, the journey of envoys like Steve Witkoff and Jared Kushner to Moscow and Kyiv embodies the difficult, often fragile, pursuit of peace. Matthew 5:9 reminds us that blessed are the peacemakers, for they will be called children of God, highlighting the divine value placed on those who strive to mend brokenness and foster...
reflection.zh: 在一个厌倦冲突的世界里，史蒂夫·维特科夫和贾里德·库什纳等特使前往莫斯科和基辅的行程，体现了艰难而脆弱的和平追求。马太福音 5:9 提醒我们，和睦的人有福了，因为他们必称为神的儿子，这突显了神对那些即使在根深蒂固的敌对情绪中，仍努力弥合破裂、促进和解的人的珍视。

verse.textEn: Blessed are the peacemakers, for they will be called children of God.
verse.textZh: 使人和睦的人有福了，因为他们必称为神的儿子。

title.en: Protester attacked at Reform conference considering coming forward after police appeal – UK politics live
title.zh: 法拉奇和詹里克将在改革会议最后一天发表演讲，会议被丑闻和抗议活动笼罩——英国政治直播

summary.en: Farage, who had earlier suspended two close aides, had his keynote speech interrupted multiple times by protesters on Friday. No real mention by Anderson of the problems that overshadowed events yesterday. He ended his opening speech saying: "Yesterday was great. Today is going..."
summary.zh: 法拉奇此前曾暂停两名亲密助手的工作，周五他的主题演讲多次被抗议者打断。安德森并未真正提及昨天笼罩事件的那些问题。他结束开幕演讲时说：“昨天很棒。今天正在……”。

body.en:
Activist group Climate Resistance claimed responsibility for the protest during Nigel Farage’s speech yesterday, PA reports.

In a comment, the group said it was “horrified at the violence” from Reform conference audience members (see post at 12:08 ).

The group also said the protester is considering whether to come forward to police.
body.zh: 据巴勒斯坦权力机构报道，活动组织“气候抵抗组织”声称对奈杰尔·法拉奇昨天演讲期间的抗议活动负责。 该组织在评论中表示，它对改革会议观众的“暴力行为感到震惊”（见 12:08 的帖子）。 该组织还表示，抗议者正在考虑是否向警方挺身而出。

reflection.en: The political conference, intended for policy discussion, is overshadowed by scandal and protest. This situation highlights a deep yearning for justice and accountability when political processes become mired in controversy. May leaders heed the call for righteousness to flow like a mighty river, bringing clarity and fairness to public life.
reflection.zh: 这场本应是政策讨论的政治会议，却被丑闻和抗议活动所笼罩。这种情况凸显了当政治进程陷入争议时，人们对公正和问责的深切渴望。愿领导者能听从那呼唤公义如江河滔滔的教导，为公众生活带来清晰和公平。

verse.textEn: Let justice roll on like a river, righteousness like a never-failing stream!
verse.textZh: 惟愿公平如大水滚滚，使公义如江河滔滔。

title.en: ‘The chancellor is in a bind’: is No 11 at odds with Burnham’s big vision?
title.zh: “财政大臣左右为难”：唐宁街11号是否与伯纳姆的宏伟愿景不合拍？

summary.en: MPs applaud the Prime Minister's ambition and optimism, but John Healey has yet to show he can match the leader's radical perspective. Until now, Andy Burnham has been a lucky prime minister. In office for just over six weeks, no major domestic crisis derailed his plans over the summer, Reform has been on the back...
summary.zh: 议员们赞扬了首相的雄心和乐观精神，但约翰·希利尚未证明他能匹配领导人的激进视角。到目前为止，安迪·伯纳姆一直是一位幸运的总理。上任仅六周多，夏季期间没有重大的国内危机阻碍了他的计划，改革派处于守势，他回到威斯敏斯特时，个人支持率飙升，乐观情绪未减。然而，许多工党议员感到庆幸，他们推翻基尔·斯塔默的高风险赌博——至少目前...

body.en: MPs applaud PM’s ambition and optimism but John Healey has yet to show he can match leader’s radical perspective Until now, Andy Burnham has been a lucky prime minister. In office for just over six weeks, no major domestic crisis derailed his plans over the summer, Reform has been on the back foot , and he arrived back at Westminster with his personal approval ratings soaring and optimism undampened. But underneath the sense of relief that many Labour MPs are feeling that their high-stakes gamble of ousting Keir Starmer appears – for now – to have paid off, there is an unease that Burnham’s premiership is yet to make contact with economic reality. Continue reading...
body.zh: 议员们对总理的雄心和乐观表示赞赏，但约翰·希利尚未证明他可以与领导人的激进观点相媲美。到目前为止，安迪·伯纳姆一直是一位幸运的总理。就任仅六周多一点，没有重大国内危机破坏他整个夏天的计划，改革一直处于不利地位，而他回到威斯敏斯特时，个人支持率飙升，乐观情绪也丝毫未减。但在许多工党议员感到他们驱逐凯尔·斯塔默的高风险赌博目前看来已经得到回报的欣慰感之下，人们对伯纳姆的首相任期尚未与经济现实联系起来感到不安。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The news highlights a tension between ambitious political vision and the grounding necessity of economic reality. Leaders are called not only to inspire but also to govern with practical wisdom. Micah 6:8 reminds us that true leadership involves acting justly, loving mercy, and walking humbly with Yahweh, balancing grand plans with the concrete needs of the...
reflection.zh: 这则新闻突显了宏伟的政治愿景与经济现实的根本需求之间的紧张关系。领导人不仅被呼召去激励人心，还要以务实的智慧去治理。弥迦书6:8提醒我们，真正的领导力包括秉行公义、喜爱怜悯、谦卑地与雅伟同行，在宏伟计划与人民的实际需求及国家资源之间取得平衡。

verse.textEn: What does Yahweh require of you? To act justly and to love mercy and to walk humbly with your God.
verse.textZh: 雅伟向你所要的是什么呢？只要你行公义，好怜悯，存谦卑的心，与你的神同行。

title.en: What different world maps get right - and what they get wrong
title.zh: 不同世界地图的对与错

summary.en: The UN has adopted a new world map projection, the Equal Earth, to more accurately represent the size of continents like Africa, which appears much smaller on the traditional Mercator map. This change aims to correct significant distortions in the widely used Mercator projection, though the new map also has its own...
summary.zh: 联合国已采用新的世界地图投影——“均等地球”投影，以更准确地表示非洲等大陆的面积，而传统麦卡托投影图上的非洲显得小得多。此举旨在纠正广泛使用的麦卡托投影图中的严重失真，尽管新地图也有其自身的局限性。

body.en:
The UN has just called for the predominant world map to be replaced with one that more accurately reflects the true size of continents like Africa.

The "Correct the Map" resolution adopted by the General Assembly aims to fix the discrepancy on the Mercator map, in which the African continent is shown as being of similar size to Greenland - even though it is in reality about 14 times larger.

It adopted a new map, the Equal Earth projection, which better represents the true sizes of landmasses - but comes with problems of its own.

There have been many prominent attempts over the years to solve the problem of accurately representing the surface of a sphere on a flat rectangle, each with its own benefits and drawbacks.

The now widely used Mercator map was created in 1569 by Flemish cartographer Gerardus Mercator.

Its main purpose was to help European sailors navigate the oceans, as cartography Professor James Cheshire at University London College explained.

"He wanted a straight line to be drawn on a map to look like a straight line in reality if you followed a compass bearing," he told the BBC. "That was what it was intended to do, and that's what it does brilliantly well."

To keep those angles correct on a flat map, Mercator had to stretch the grid lines wider as they moved away from the equator toward the poles.

His map accommodates for the curvature of the Earth by making countries near the equator seem much smaller than they are, with countries nearer the poles appearing stretched.

The distortion is a result of it being impossible to accurately represent the surface of a globe on a two-dimensional chart.

More than 450 years on, Mercator's creation is still the basis for many of the maps we see in classrooms, on TV and online, including Google Maps.

But critics of the Mercator map say there is a psychological effect to viewing some places as smaller than they actually are and others as larger, as we instinctively view bigger things as more important.

For Kenyan geographer Kioko Muendo, this has implicitly downplayed Africa's vast resources, population and investment opportunities.

"Maps are more than just guides for travellers - they shape how regions are perceived politically and economically," he told the BBC.

It was developed by a team of cartographers in 2018 to present the size and shape of landmasses more accurately.

As a result, the Equal Earth map was initially adopted by 54 members of the African Union, before being adopted by the UN.

But to do this, it sacrifices the straight lines that made the Mercator projection perfect for navigating with - and it cannot be used for measuring the true distance between different places.

"You can preserve area, or you can preserve shape, or you can preserve distance and direction, but...
body.zh: 联合国刚刚呼吁用一张更准确地反映非洲等大陆真实面积的世界地图来取代主要的世界地图。 大会通过的“修正地图”决议旨在解决墨卡托地图上的差异，该地图显示非洲大陆与格陵兰岛大小相似，尽管实际上它大约大14倍。 它采用了新的地图，即平等地球投影，它更好地代表了陆地的真实大小，但也有其自身的问题。 多年来，为了解决在平面矩形上精确表示球体表面的问题，人们进行了许多著名的尝试，每种尝试都有其自身的优点和缺点。 现在广泛使用的墨卡托地图是由佛兰芒制图师 Gerardus Mercator 于 1569 年创建的。 伦敦大学学院制图学教授詹姆斯·切希尔（James Cheshire）解释说，其主要目的是帮助欧洲水手在海洋中航行。 他告诉英国广播公司：“他希望在地图上画一条直线，如果你遵循罗盘方位，看起来就像现实中的直线一样。” “这就是它的目的，而且它做得非常出色。” 为了在平面地图上保持这些角度正确，墨卡托必须在网格线从赤道向两极移动时将其拉得更宽。 他的地图适应了地球的曲率，使赤道附近的国家看起来比实际小得多，而靠近两极的国家则显得被拉伸。 这种扭曲是由于无法在二维图表上准确表示地球表面而造成的。 450 多年过去了，墨卡托的创作仍然是我们在教室、电视和网上看到的许多地图（包括 Google 地图）的基础。 但墨卡托地图的批评者表示，将某些地方视为比实际小而将其他地方视为大会产生心理效应，因为我们本能地认为更大的事物更重要。 对于肯尼亚地理学家 Kioko Muendo 来说，这暗中淡化了非洲丰富的资源、人口和投资机会。 他告诉英国广播公司：“地图不仅仅是旅行者的指南，它们还塑造了人们对地区政治和经济的看法。” 它由制图师团队于 2018 年开发，旨在更准确地呈现陆地的大小和形状。 因此，平等地球地图最初被非洲联盟 54 个成员国通过，随后被联合国通过。 但要做到这一点，它牺牲了使墨卡托投影完美用于导航的直线 - 并且它不能用于测量不同地点之间的真实距离。 “你可以保留面积，或者你可以保留形状，或者你可以保留距离和方向，但是......

reflection.en: The UN's adoption of the Equal Earth projection is a step toward more accurate representation, acknowledging that our understanding and tools for depicting the world are not static. This echoes the prophetic insight that in the end times, 'knowledge shall increase,' suggesting a continuous unfolding of understanding and refinement of our perspectives.
reflection.zh: 联合国采用“均等地球”投影是迈向更准确表述的一步，它承认我们理解和描绘世界的方式并非一成不变。这呼应了预言中关于末世“知识必增长”的见解，暗示着理解的不断展开和我们视角的不断完善。

verse.textEn: But you, Daniel, roll up and seal the words of the scroll until the time of the end. Many will go here and there to increase knowledge.
verse.textZh: 但以理啊，你要隐藏这话，封闭这书，直到末时。必有多人来往奔跑，知识就必增长。

title.en: US envoys arrive in Moscow ahead of Ukraine talks
title.zh: 美代表抵达莫斯科，为乌克兰会谈做准备

summary.en: Two US envoys, Steve Witkoff and Jared Kushner, have arrived in Moscow to hold talks aimed at accelerating efforts to end the war in Ukraine. They are expected to present a proposal to end the conflict before traveling to Kyiv on Sunday.
summary.zh: 美国特使史蒂夫·维特科夫和贾里德·库什纳已抵达莫斯科，旨在加速结束乌克兰战争的会谈。他们预计将在周日前往基辅之前提出一项结束冲突的提议。

body.en:
Two of US President Donald Trump's top envoys have arrived in Moscow ahead of a weekend of talks aimed at accelerating efforts to end the war in Ukraine.

Steve Witkoff and Jared Kushner will hold talks in the Russian capital before travelling to Kyiv on Sunday for discussions with Ukraine.

Russia's President Vladimir Putin ordered a halt to strikes on Kyiv for three days due to the US visit, state media reported, citing the Kremlin.

Trump told reporters on Friday that Witkoff and Kushner were "bringing with them a proposal to end the war". So far, efforts from the US and its allies to broker a peace deal have failed to deliver a breakthrough.

US news outlet Axios reported that the US envoys would separately meet both Russian President Vladimir Putin and Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky.

Kushner and Witkoff have visited Russia several times but the talks on Sunday would be the first in Ukraine.

The pair were pictured being greeted by Russian diplomat Kirill Dmitriev after landing at Moscow's Vnukovo Airport.

Flight tracking data showed a US government plane had travelled from Helsinki, Finland, where it flown to from the US earlier in the day.

Earlier on Saturday, Zelensky said Russia had fired "demonstrative" strikes on airports in Kyiv and Boryspil overnight ahead of his planned meeting with the US.

Ukraine's president added: "Clearly, these Russian strikes on the airports are a reaction to the discussions and preparations for the possibility of the US side using an aircraft to travel to Ukraine and land at Kyiv Airport or Boryspil Airport."

Ukraine's airspace has been closed since Russia launched its full-scale invasion in February 2022.

Zelensky said on Friday he would guarantee the safety of Russian airspace during the envoys' visit and called for Russia to do the same for Ukraine.

He also said an overnight Russian strike on a civilian building in the Dnipro region killed four people and injured five others.

Witkoff and Kushner's visit to Moscow comes just over a week after a rare visit to the Russian capital by the head of the CIA, John Ratcliffe.

There was no official comment from Washington or the Kremlin on what was discussed. Speaking last week, Trump described the meeting as "semi-routine".

Last year, the US, Ukraine and Russia separately suggested that a deal to end the war was edging closer following a flurry of talks brokered by the Americans.

European allies also held talks in Paris but discussions ultimately ended without a breakthrough. Key disagreements remain between the warring sides on issues such as territory and security guarantees for Ukraine.

In recent months, both Russia and Ukraine have intensified their aerial attacks as fighting continues.

reflection.en: As US envoys arrive in Moscow carrying a proposal to end the war in Ukraine, we are reminded of the blessedness of peacemakers. May their efforts be guided by wisdom and a genuine desire for reconciliation, reflecting the hope for peace that transcends conflict.
reflection.zh: 随着美国特使抵达莫斯科，并带着结束乌克兰战争的提议，我们被提醒那些制造和平的人是有福的。愿他们的努力得到智慧和真正和解的愿望的指引，反映出超越冲突的和平希望。

verse.textEn: Blessed are the peacemakers, for they will be called children of God.
verse.textZh: 使人和睦的人有福了，因为他们必称为神的儿子。

title.en: The US is stepping up its attacks in Iran. The latest is very close to a key asset.
title.zh: 美军袭击伊朗油轮，地点靠近关键资产

summary.en: A semi-official Iranian news agency reported that a tanker was hit by four US missiles near Kharg Island, a key oil export hub. Local sources indicated no casualties, and the crew was being evacuated. The incident occurred after US President Donald Trump had previously suggested Kharg Island might be targeted.
summary.zh: 伊朗半官方通讯社报道称，一艘油轮在伊朗主要石油出口中心哈尔格岛附近遭到美军四枚导弹袭击。当地消息人士称无人员伤亡，船员正在被疏散。此前美国总统特朗普曾暗示哈尔格岛可能成为目标。

body.en:
An Iranian tanker was hit by US forces on Saturday near Iran's key oil export hub, Kharg Island, in the Gulf, the semi-official Iranian news agency Tasnim reported.

According to a Tasnim correspondent from Kharg, the tanker was hit by four US missiles in the area of Kharg Island's anchorage.

Tasnim quoted local sources as saying there were no casualties and the tanker's crew was being evacuated.

There was no immediate official announcement by Iranian authorities and US Central Command did not immediately respond to a request for comment.

US President Donald Trump said on 31 August in a one-line social media post accompanied by an AI-generated video that Kharg Island was being "blown to smithereens". Iranian authorities have vowed a strong response if Kharg is attacked.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

Iran is the third-largest producer in the Organization of the Petroleum Exporting ‌Countries and exported 90 per cent of its crude via Kharg Island before the war, but flows have been disrupted since a US blockade of Iranian oil exports began in mid-April.

Trump said on 11 June that he wanted to take over Kharg Island, but then said a threatened US military operation there was off the table for now, days before Tehran and Washington signed an interim agreement aimed at ending the war on 17 June.

A US attack on Kharg would heap further pressure on Iran's oil industry and its wider economy, which is already reeling from the US naval blockade.

The US imposed its blockade on Iranian ports after Iran effectively shut the Strait of Hormuz, a key waterway that carried one-fifth of the world's oil supply before the war.

title.en: Why many Syrians feel Assad's death sentence isn't enough
title.zh: 为何许多叙利亚人认为阿萨德的死刑不够

summary.en: In July, a Syrian court sentenced former dictator Bashar Assad to death for crimes against his own people. However, after 14 years of civil war, many survivors are seeking more comprehensive transitional justice.
summary.zh: 今年七月，一家叙利亚法院判处叙利亚前独裁者巴沙尔·阿萨德死刑，罪名是他危害本国人民。然而，在经历了14年的内战后，许多幸存者正在寻求更全面的过渡性正义。

body.en:
In July, a Syrian court sentenced former dictator Bashar Assad to death for crimes against his own people. But after 14 years of civil war, many survivors are demanding more when it comes to transitional justice.

Huda Khayti often finds herself returning to the place where she lost almost everything. Khayti, a Syrian women's rights activist, survived a 2013 chemical weapons attack on the east Ghouta region by forces of the former Syrian dictator Bashar Assad. 

Her brother was killed by the bombs of the Assad regime and its allies. Her women's center was destroyed along with her home and in 2018, she had to leave her hometown of Douma — a major city in Ghouta — and flee to Idlib, a rebel stronghold in northern Syria.

Today, Khayti regularly visits her hometown, which is about 10 kilometers (about 6 miles) northeast of the country's capital, Damascus. Since the Assad regime was overthrown in late 2024, Khayti has traveled regularly between Idlib and Douma, where she's even working on opening a new women's center.

"Ghouta means so much to me emotionally," she told DW. But every time she returns there, she is also confronted with remnants of the civil war. "When I'm traveling through the country I see traces of war everywhere, so many houses and so much infrastructure destroyed. So much suffering. So much trauma."

Almost two years since the overthrow of the Assad regime,  Syria has started a process to examine the crimes of the regime in court. In mid-August a Damascus court sentenced Bashar Assad and other high-ranking members of his regime to death in absentia . Assad is currently living in Russia, where he fled after his government was overthrown. Many senior officials are also there or hiding elsewhere.

Among other things, Assad was found guilty of premeditated murder, torture and depriving individuals of their liberty. The court said these were war crimes and crimes against humanity.

"Of course, this conviction of Assad is a good thing," Khayti said. "Even if it's only on paper. Bashar Assad may have been convicted but he just continues to live his life in Russia — like so many other Syrian criminals who fled to Russia."

The court's conviction had a big impact in Syria anyway. "The verdict had a lot of echoes by people, they were so happy," said Lina Chawaf, a Syrian journalist, media expert and researcher at Harvard University's Center for Middle Eastern Studies. "Many media celebrated the verdict on the statement day as a victory and consider it as part of transitional justice."

Still, it remains unclear whether there will be any actual punishment following the conviction. Although Russia and Syria agreed on an extradition treaty in 2023, observers say it's unlikely Russia would send Assad, a long-time ally, back to Syria....
body.zh: 7月，叙利亚法院以针对本国人民的罪行判处前独裁者巴沙尔·阿萨德死刑。但经过 14 年的内战，许多幸存者对过渡时期司法提出了更多要求。 胡达·卡蒂 (Huda Khayti) 经常发现自己回到了几乎失去一切的地方。 2013 年，叙利亚前独裁者巴沙尔·阿萨德的军队对东古塔地区发动化学武器袭击，叙利亚妇女权利活动家卡伊蒂 (Khayti) 幸存下来。 她的兄弟被阿萨德政权及其盟友的炸弹炸死。她的妇女中心和她的家一起被摧毁，2018 年，她不得不离开家乡杜马（古塔的一个主要城市），逃到叙利亚北部叛军据点伊德利卜。 如今，海蒂定期回访她的家乡，该家乡位于该国首都大马士革东北约 10 公里（约 6 英里）处。自 2024 年底阿萨德政权被推翻以来，海蒂经常往返于伊德利卜和杜马之间，她甚至正在致力于在那里开设一个新的妇女中心。 “古塔在情感上对我来说意义重大，”她告诉德国之声。但每次她回到那里，她也面临着内战的残余。 “当我在这个国家旅行时，我到处都看到战争的痕迹，如此多的房屋和如此多的基础设施被毁。如此多的苦难。如此多的创伤。” 阿萨德政权被推翻近两年后，叙利亚已开始在法庭上审查该政权的罪行。八月中旬，大马士革法院缺席判处巴沙尔·阿萨德及其政权的其他高级成员死刑。阿萨德目前居住在俄罗斯，他在政府被推翻后逃离俄罗斯。许多高级官员也在那里或躲在其他地方。 除其他外，阿萨德被判犯有预谋谋杀、酷刑和剥夺个人自由的罪名。法院称这些都是战争罪和反人类罪。 “当然，阿萨德被定罪是一件好事，”海蒂说。 “即使只是在纸面上。巴沙尔·阿萨德可能已被定罪，但他只是继续在俄罗斯生活——就像许多其他逃往俄罗斯的叙利亚罪犯一样。” 无论如何，法院的判决对叙利亚产生了巨大影响。 “这一判决得到了很多人的响应，他们非常高兴，”叙利亚记者、媒体专家、哈佛大学中东研究中心研究员莉娜·查瓦夫(Lina Chawaf)说。 “许多媒体在声明日庆祝判决为胜利，并将其视为过渡司法的一部分。” 不过，目前尚不清楚定罪后是否会受到任何实际惩罚。尽管俄罗斯和叙利亚在 2023 年达成了引渡条约，但观察人士表示，俄罗斯不太可能将长期盟友阿萨德送回叙利亚。

reflection.en: The Syrian civil war has inflicted immense suffering, leaving survivors with deep wounds and a profound yearning for justice. While a court's sentence against Bashar Assad may seem like a step, the lingering sentiment among survivors underscores a broader crisis where justice itself feels broken and accountability incomplete. This reflects the lament in...
reflection.zh: 叙利亚内战造成了巨大的苦难，给幸存者留下了深刻的创伤和对正义的深切渴望。虽然法院对巴沙尔·阿萨德的判决可能看似是一个进步，但幸存者挥之不去的感受凸显了一个更广泛的危机：正义本身似乎被扭曲，问责不完整。这呼应了哈巴谷先知的哀叹，他为正义的颠倒和恶人的逍遥而呼喊，这种呼喊在那些遭受如此巨大损失的人心中回响。

verse.textEn: The law is paralyzed, and justice never prevails. The wicked hem in the righteous, so that justice is perverted.
verse.textZh: 因此律法放松，公理也不显明；恶人围困义人，所以公理显然颠倒。

title.en: The 'grave threat' that landed the Vice President of the Philippines in court
title.zh: 让菲律宾副总统登上法庭的“严重威胁”

summary.en: Philippine Vice President Sara Duterte posted bail on Saturday, a day after an arrest warrant was issued for allegedly making death threats against the country's president. She faces charges of 'grave threats' stemming from a news briefing where she claimed to have hired a hitman to kill President Ferdinand Marcos and...
summary.zh: 菲律宾副总统萨拉·杜特尔特于周六在马尼拉一家法院办理了保释手续，此前一天，针对她涉嫌对总统发出死亡威胁的逮捕令已被签发。她面临“严重威胁”的指控，源于一次深夜新闻发布会，会上她声称如果自己先遭不测，就雇佣杀手杀死总统费迪南德·马科斯及其妻子。这一威胁也是她正在进行的参议院弹劾审判的关键部分。

body.en:
Philippine Vice President Sara Duterte posted bail at a Manila courthouse on Saturday, a day after an arrest warrant was issued over her alleged death threat against the country's president.

Duterte was charged last month with "grave threats" stemming from a late-night news briefing in which she claimed to have hired a hitman to kill President Ferdinand Marcos, his wife and a congressman cousin should she be cut down first.

The alleged assassination threat also forms a crucial element of her ongoing Senate impeachment trial, where a guilty verdict would see her removed from office and permanently banned from politics.

"The vice president voluntarily appeared before the court that issued the warrant, so there was no need for her to be arrested," her lawyer Lawrence Lim said after Duterte emerged from the regional courthouse holding a court order confirming she had posted a cash bond.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

"I don't want to (post bail) if no one is watching," she said, claiming to be the victim of police harassment.

"Will they throw me into the (jail) and then one night I die in my sleep?" she said.

Under the Philippine legal code, a criminal conviction on the "grave threats" charge would carry a jail term of up to six months.

The vice president's legal team issued a statement on Friday saying she had "no intention of evading the law and will continue to exercise all her legal remedies".

Justice department officials have rejected her lawyers' argument that she cannot be prosecuted for offences that are also tied to her impeachment.

Duterte was impeached in May by the House of Representatives, the lower chamber of parliament, on charges that also included graft and corruption.

A guilty verdict in the Senate — where her trial recently concluded its ninth week — would spell an end to a planned run for president in 2028.

body.zh: 菲律宾副总统萨拉·杜特尔特周六在马尼拉法院获得保释，一天前，她因涉嫌对该国总统发出死亡威胁而发出逮捕令。 杜特尔特上个月在一次深夜新闻发布会上被指控“严重威胁”，她在新闻发布会上声称，如果她先被砍倒，她将雇佣一名杀手杀死费迪南德·马科斯总统、他的妻子和一名国会议员表弟。 所谓的暗杀威胁也是她正在进行的参议院弹劾审判的一个关键因素，如果有罪判决，她将被免职并永久禁止从政。 在杜特尔特从地区法院出来时，她拿着法庭命令，确认她已缴纳了现金保证金，她的律师劳伦斯·林(Lawrence Lim)表示，“副总统自愿出现在发出逮捕令的法院，因此没有必要逮捕她。” 您值得信赖的来源，让您了解周围世界的最新动态。直接将免费的每日新闻更新和分析发送到您的收件箱。 “如果没有人在场，我不想（保释），”她说，并声称自己是警察骚扰的受害者。 “他们会把我扔进（监狱），然后有一天晚上我在睡梦中死去吗？”她说。 根据菲律宾法律，对“严重威胁”指控的刑事定罪将被判处最高六个月的监禁。 副总统的法律团队周五发表声明称，她“无意逃避法律，并将继续行使所有法律补救措施”。 司法部官员驳回了她的律师的论点，即她不能因与弹劾有关的罪行而受到起诉。 杜特尔特五月被众议院（议会下议院）弹劾，指控还包括贪污和腐败。 参议院对她的审判最近结束了第九周，如果参议院做出有罪判决，她的 2028 年总统竞选计划就将结束。 如需了解 SBS 新闻的最新动态，请下载我们的应用程序并订阅我们的时事通讯。

The prophet Micah reminds us that true leadership is defined not by power or...
reflection.zh: 菲律宾副总统萨拉·杜特尔特被捕并获得保释的消息，凸显了公职人员所作威胁的严重后果。这些“严重威胁”的指控以及正在进行的弹劾审判，都强调了领导层问责制的重要性。先知弥迦提醒我们，真正的领导力并非由权力和地位定义，而是由‘施行公平、喜爱慈爱、谦卑同行’的承诺所定义。

verse.textEn: What does Yahweh require of you? To act justly and to love mercy and to walk humbly with your God.

title.en: Outrage as Maltese tycoon acquitted in journalist's murder
title.zh: 震惊：马耳他巨头记者谋杀案无罪

summary.en: Maltese businessman Yorgen Fenech has been acquitted of complicity in the murder of journalist Daphne Caruana Galizia. The verdict, delivered nearly nine years after the attack, leaves the question of who ordered her death unresolved, sparking outrage from the public and the victim's family.
summary.zh: 马耳他商人尤尔根·费内赫被判无罪，此前他被指控共谋杀害记者达芙妮·卡鲁阿纳·加利齐亚。这起袭击事件发生近九年后，谁下令杀害她的问题仍未得到解答，这在公众和受害者家属中引发了愤怒。

body.en:
Maltese businessman Yorgen Fenech has been found not guilty of complicity to murder journalist Daphne Caruana Galizia. Almost nine years after the attack, the question of who ordered her death remains unanswered.

As Yorgen Fenech left the courthouse in Valletta on Wednesday evening, he was confronted by the furious crowd outside. The 44-year-old Maltese businessman pushed through, flanked by his security guards. Just minutes earlier, a jury had acquitted him of ordering the murder of the 53-year-old investigative journalist Daphne Caruana Galizia.

The verdict came as a shock to her family. Her son, Matthew Caruana Galizia, said it was a "terrible decision by the jurors that our country may never recover from." He later doubled down on his criticism, describing the verdict in a post on Facebook as "obscene" and saying: "Their decision flies in the face of all evidence, of all logic, of the truth."

Almost nine years after Caruana Galizia's murder, Malta is again confronted with the crucial question: Who was responsible for her death on October 16, 2017? The men who procured the bomb, placed it under the driver's seat and detonated it remotely have already been convicted . But the person who contracted them to do it has still not been legally identified.

For years, Fenech was considered to be the central figure in the investigations. His arrest on the morning of November 20, 2019, was like something out of a movie. His luxury yacht, Gio, had just left harbor when it was stopped by a Maltese military patrol boat. Fenech was arrested on board and subsequently interrogated by the police.

Fenech's arrest, and suspicion that people in government circles were involved in the crime, sparked protests all across the country. Joseph Muscat, prime minister at the time, was accused of protecting political allies and stepped down in January 2020. Fenech spent more than five years in detention before being released on bail, under strict conditions, in early 2025.

His trial only began this summer , and the final verdict was decisive. Eight of the nine jurors rejected the prosecution's argument that it was Fenech who had ordered the journalist's murder.

The prosecution case relied above all on the testimony of Melvin Theuma, who confessed to being the middleman and testified that Fenech had contracted him to organize the murder. Theuma received a pardon in exchange for his cooperation.

But Fenech's defense called Theuma's credibility into question, highlighting contradictions in his testimony and false statements he had made previously.

Fenech's lawyers also sought to prove that evidence pointing to Keith Schembri, chief of staff to Muscat at the time, was not properly followed up. Schembri has denied any involvement in the murder, and the...
body.zh: 马耳他商人约根·费内奇 (Yorgen Fenech) 被判无罪谋杀记者达芙妮·卡鲁阿纳·加利齐亚 (Daphne Caruana Galizia)。袭击发生近九年后，谁下令杀害她的问题仍然没有答案。 周三晚上，当约根·费内奇 (Yorgen Fenech) 离开瓦莱塔法院时，他遇到了外面愤怒的人群。这位 44 岁的马耳他商人在保安的簇拥下推门而入。就在几分钟前，陪审团宣布他下令谋杀 53 岁调查记者达芙妮·卡鲁阿纳·加利齐亚 (Daphne Caruana Galizia) 无罪。 这一判决令她的家人感到震惊。她的儿子马修·卡鲁阿纳·加利齐亚 (Matthew Caruana Galizia) 表示，这是“陪审团做出的可怕决定，我们的国家可能永远无法从中恢复过来”。后来他加大了批评力度，在脸书上发帖称这一判决“淫秽”，并表示：“他们的决定违背了所有证据、所有逻辑和事实。” 卡鲁阿娜·加利齐亚 (Caruana Galizia) 被谋杀近九年后，马耳他再次面临关键问题：谁应对 2017 年 10 月 16 日她的死亡负责？购买炸弹、将其放置在驾驶员座椅下并远程引爆的人已被定罪。但与他们签约的人的身份仍未得到合法确认。 多年来，费内奇被认为是调查的核心人物。他于2019年11月20日上午被捕，就像电影里的情节一样。他的豪华游艇“Gio”刚刚离开港口，就被一艘马耳他军事巡逻艇拦住。费内奇在船上被捕，随后受到警方审问。 费内奇被捕，以及政府人士涉嫌参与犯罪的怀疑，引发了全国各地的抗议活动。时任总理约瑟夫·马斯喀特 (Joseph Muscat) 被指控保护政治盟友，并于 2020 年 1 月下台。费内奇 (Fenech) 被拘留了五年多，然后于 2025 年初在严格条件下获得保释。 他的审判今年夏天才开始，最终的判决是决定性的。九名陪审员中的八名驳回了检方关于是费内奇下令谋杀记者的论点。 检方的指控首先依赖于梅尔文·西玛 (Melvin Theuma) 的证词，他承认自己是中间人，并证明芬内奇与他签约组织了这起谋杀案。作为合作的交换，Theuma 获得了赦免。 但费内奇的辩护对西玛的可信度提出了质疑，强调了他的证词中的矛盾以及他之前所做的虚假陈述。 费内奇的律师还试图证明指向当时马斯喀特参谋长基思·谢姆布里的证据没有得到适当的跟进。申布里否认与这起谋杀案有任何牵连，而且……

reflection.en: The acquittal of Yorgen Fenech in the murder of Daphne Caruana Galizia leaves a deep wound of injustice. The family's anguish and the public's fury underscore the cry for accountability when the legal system fails to deliver justice. This echoes Habakkuk's lament over a broken justice system, where the law is paralyzed and the wicked go unpunished.
reflection.zh: 尤尔根·费内赫在达芙妮·卡鲁阿纳·加利齐亚谋杀案中的无罪判决留下了深深的不公创伤。家属的痛苦和公众的愤怒，凸显了当法律体系未能伸张正义时，对问责制的呼喊。这呼应了哈巴谷对破碎司法体系的哀叹，即法律瘫痪而恶人逍遥法外。

verse.textEn: The law is paralyzed, and justice never prevails. The wicked hem in the righteous, so that justice is perverted.
verse.textZh: 因此律法放松，公理也不显明；恶人围困义人，所以公理显然颠倒。

title.en: Rescuers in Nepal find two more people alive after flash flood disaster
title.zh: 尼泊尔洪水灾难：救援人员在洪灾后找到另外两人活口

summary.en: Rescuers in Nepal have found two more survivors, a Chinese man at the Trishuli hydropower project and a Nepali woman in Nuwakot, ten days after massive floods hit the country. The Chinese man was rescued from a 225-meter tunnel and is undergoing a health assessment, while the search continues for thousands still...
summary.zh: 尼泊尔洪水灾难发生十天后，救援人员找到了另外两名幸存者：一名在中国水电项目中被困的中国男子和一名在努瓦科特的尼泊尔妇女。这名中国男子从225米深的隧道中被救出，目前正在接受健康评估，搜救行动仍在继续，仍有数千人失踪。

body.en: Chinese man at Trishuli hydropower project and Nepali woman in Nuwakot found 10 days into rescue operation Emergency responders have rescued a Chinese man and a Nepali woman in two separate operations as authorities continued to search for thousands of people missing 10 days after massive floods hit Nepal. The Nepali military said on Saturday a joint team comprising personnel from its army and South Korean disaster experts rescued the man from a 225-metre (740ft) tunnel in the Upper Trishuli-1 hydropower project, and that he was undergoing a health assessment. Pictures showed him being evacuated by helicopter after being carried out of the tunnel. Continue reading...
body.zh: 特里苏里水电项目的中国男子和努瓦科特的尼泊尔妇女在救援行动进行10天后被发现 周六，紧急救援人员在两次单独的行动中救出了一名中国男子和一名尼泊尔妇女，尼泊尔大洪水袭击10天后，当局仍在继续搜寻数千名失踪人员。尼泊尔军方表示，一支由军队人员和韩国灾难专家组成的联合小组从上特里苏里一号水电项目的一条 225 米（740 英尺）长的隧道中救出了这名男子，目前他正在接受健康评估。照片显示，他被带出隧道后被直升机疏散。继续阅读...

reflection.en: In the midst of devastating floods in Nepal, the discovery of survivors ten days later offers a profound glimmer of hope. These rescues, like finding a stranger in distress, echo the words of Jesus: "Truly I tell you, whatever you did for one of the least of these brothers and sisters of mine, you did for me." It reminds us that every life is precious and...
reflection.zh: 在尼泊尔毁灭性的洪水灾难中，十天后发现幸存者带来了深刻的希望之光。这些救援行动，如同在困境中找到陌生人一样，呼应了耶稣的话：“我实在告诉你们，这些事你们既做在我这弟兄中一个最小的身上，就是做在我身上了。”这提醒我们，每一个生命都无比珍贵，每一次救援行动都是神圣的职责。

verse.textEn: Truly I tell you, whatever you did for one of the least of these brothers and sisters of mine, you did for me.
verse.textZh: 我实在告诉你们，这些事你们既做在我这弟兄中一个最小的身上，就是做在我身上了。

title.en: India news: 275 Indians still missing in Nepal floods
title.zh: 印度新闻：尼泊尔洪水仍有275名印度人失踪

summary.en: Official estimates indicate that 275 Indians remain unaccounted for following the catastrophic floods in Nepal. Concurrently, reports suggest no Indian travelers are stranded in flood-affected Tibet.
summary.zh: 官方估计显示，在尼泊尔灾难性的洪水之后，仍有275名印度人下落不明。与此同时，有报道称没有印度旅客滞留在受洪水影响的西藏地区。

body.zh: 官方估计，尼泊尔洪水灾难中仍有 275 名印度人下落不明。与此同时，据说没有印度游客滞留在受洪水影响的西藏。 DW还有更多。 厌倦了错过我们的实时更新？单击此处将我们添加为 Google 上的首选来源。然后点击“星标”或“首选”，将 DW News 保留在您的 Feed 顶部。 印度表示，在山洪袭击尼泊尔和西藏边境地区十天后，仍有 275 名印度国民失踪。 印度外交部发言人兰迪尔·贾伊斯瓦尔(Randhir Jaiswal)周五晚间表示，迄今为止，尼泊尔洪灾地区共有169名印度人获救。 杰斯瓦尔表示，在最新的救援行动中，三名印度人，包括一名五岁儿童，被从尼泊尔特里苏利集市救至安全地带。 “我们驻尼泊尔大使馆正在协助他们乘飞机返回印度，”他在 X 日表示。 该发言人在新德里举行的新闻发布会上表示，1,907 名印度国民已从中国安全越境前往尼泊尔。 杰斯瓦尔援引中国官方消息来源宣布，目前没有印度旅客滞留在西藏自治区。 尼泊尔官方公布的洪水死亡人数目前为 1,294 人，仍有 5,053 人失踪。 为了寻找幸存者，疯狂的救援工作已经持续了数天，特别是在充满泥浆的水电隧道中，据信有数百名工人被困。 周六，新德里驻加德满都特使表示，印度隧道救援队与尼泊尔国防军在拉苏瓦奇莱姆水电站合作，已加强行动。 印度大使纳文·斯里瓦斯塔瓦（Naveen Srivastava）表示：“昨天，印度隧道救援队与尼泊尔军队合作，在奇莱姆隧道中挖得更深，排水。还修建了一条临时轨道，以便更多重型设备进入隧道。” 他补充说，陪同印度救援人员的医生还为当地社区举办了一个健康营。 杰斯瓦尔周五表示，自 8 月 26 日洪水袭击尼泊尔以来，印度还向尼泊尔提供了近 95 吨救灾物资。 我是来自德国之声德里工作室的 Dharvi，为您带来我们印度博客的周末版，我们将详细分析在这个世界上人口最多的国家引起轰动的所有头条新闻。 尼泊尔-西藏灾难性洪灾中仍有 275 名印度人失踪，死亡人数已突破 1,200 人。 外交消息方面，下周金砖国家峰会在新德里已经开始倒计时。印度将作为经济集团主席国接待成员国领导人。 与此同时，在体育界，印度运动员正在以一种相当非传统的方式为亚运会做准备——睡在集装箱式的单位里。

reflection.en: Amidst the devastation of the Nepal floods, 275 Indian nationals are still missing. This crisis underscores the vulnerability of travelers and the profound human need for safety and connection. In these moments of uncertainty and loss, we are called to remember that compassion extended to those in distress, even strangers, is an act of service to the divine.
reflection.zh: 在尼泊尔洪水灾难的背景下，仍有275名印度国民失踪。这场危机凸显了旅客的脆弱性以及人类对安全和联系的深切需求。在这些充满不确定和失落的时刻，我们被呼召要铭记，向处于困境中的人，即使是陌生人，伸出援手，也是一种对神圣的服侍。

verse.textEn: Truly I tell you, whatever you did for one of the least of these brothers and sisters of mine, you did for me.
verse.textZh: 我实在告诉你们，这些事你们既做在我这弟兄中一个最小的身上，就是做在我身上了。

title.en: Watch: Moment workers are rescued from Nepal tunnel
title.zh: 视频：尼泊尔隧道工人获救瞬间

summary.en: Rescuers pull two people from a hydropower tunnel more than a week after a massive flash flood devastated the Nepal-China border.
summary.zh: 在导致尼泊尔-中国边境地区遭受毁灭性洪灾一周多后，救援人员从一座水电站隧道中救出了两人。

reflection.en: In the aftermath of disaster, the focus often shifts to the immense scale of destruction. Yet, amidst the rubble and the waiting, the rescue of two individuals from the Nepal tunnel shines a light on the preciousness of each human life. Jesus taught that whatever we do for the least of these, we do for Him.
reflection.zh: 在灾难的余波中，人们的注意力常常转向巨大的破坏规模。然而，在瓦砾和等待之中，从尼泊尔隧道中救出两名个人的事件，彰显了每个人的生命都何等宝贵。耶稣教导说，凡你们为我这些最小的弟兄做的，就是为我做的。

verse.textEn: Truly I tell you, whatever you did for one of the least of these brothers and sisters of mine, you did for me.
verse.textZh: 我实在告诉你们，这些事你们既做在我这弟兄中一个最小的身上，就是做在我身上了。

title.en: ‘Everyone seems to have forgotten’: In Tibet, flood-hit families search for the missing and grapple with China’s silence
title.zh: 在西藏，“每个人似乎都已忘记”：洪水肆虐家庭寻找失踪者，并与中国的沉默作斗争

summary.en: Relatives are trying to gather information online and from Nepal, while Tibet advocacy groups report that information is being suppressed in China. Fan Hong last heard from her husband, Lin Bo, who was working on a Chinese highway project in Nepal, on the morning of the disaster. Over a week later, she is desperately...
summary.zh: 亲属们正试图从网上和尼泊尔收集信息，而西藏倡导团体则报告信息在中国受到压制。范红在尼泊尔-西藏灾难发生当晚听到了她丈夫林波的消息，林波当时正在尼泊尔的一个中国公路项目上工作。一周多过去了，她仍在绝望地寻找他，难以从当局那里获得信息，并转向了社交媒体。

body.en: Relatives try to piece together information found online and from Nepal as Tibet advocates groups say information is suppressed in China Fan Hong last heard from her husband on the morning of the Nepal-Tibet disaster. More than a week later, the 31-year-old is desperately searching for information about Lin Bo, who was working on a Chinese highway project in Nepal. Struggling to get information from authorities, Fan turned to social media for help. “My husband works on a project in Nepal, about 5 kilometres from the Gyirong border crossing. I want to know what the situation is, but I haven’t been able to reach him,” the 31-year-old from China’s Sichuan province wrote on Rednote. Continue reading...
body.zh: 亲戚们试图将网上和来自尼泊尔的信息拼凑起来，因为西藏倡导团体称信息在中国受到压制。 范红最后一次听到她丈夫的消息是在尼泊尔-西藏灾难发生的早上。一个多星期后，这位31岁的男子正在拼命寻找有关林波的信息，林波正在尼泊尔的一个中国高速公路项目上工作。由于难以从当局获取信息，范向社交媒体寻求帮助。 “我丈夫在尼泊尔的一个项目工作，距离吉隆口岸约 5 公里。我想知道情况如何，但一直联系不上他，”这位来自中国四川省的 31 岁男子在 Rednote 上写道。继续阅读...

reflection.en: In the aftermath of the Nepal-Tibet disaster, families like Fan Hong's are left in agonizing uncertainty, struggling to find information about their missing loved ones. The silence from authorities and the difficulty in accessing news echo the plight of those who are often voiceless. This situation calls us to remember and advocate for those whose suffering...
reflection.zh: 在尼泊尔-西藏灾难发生后，像范红这样的家庭陷入了痛苦的不确定之中，努力寻找失踪亲人的信息。当局的沉默和获取新闻的困难，呼应了那些常常无声者的困境。这种情况提醒我们要铭记并为那些可能被遗忘的受苦者发声，这体现了圣经中为不能为自己发声者说话的呼召。

verse.textEn: Speak up for those who cannot speak for themselves, for the rights of all who are destitute. Speak up and judge fairly; defend the rights of the poor and needy.
verse.textZh: 你当为不能自辩的开口，为孤独的伸冤。你当开口按公义判断，为困苦和穷乏的辨屈。

title.en: Pacific leaders voice concern over Chinese missile test but stop short of condemnation
title.zh: 太平洋领导人对中国导弹试验表示担忧，但未予谴责

summary.en: The Pacific Islands Forum (PIF) concluded with most member nations agreeing to "register concern" over China's recent intercontinental ballistic missile (ICBM) test, which overflew several members without adequate notice. Leaders urged transparency and advance notification for such tests, with Nauru being the sole...
summary.zh: 太平洋岛国论坛（PIF）闭幕，多数成员国同意就中国近期洲际弹道导弹（ICBM）试验“表示关切”，该试验在未获充分通知的情况下飞越了部分成员国领土。领导人敦促所有进行ICBM试验的国家确保透明度和保障，包括按照国际惯例至少提前24小时发出通知。18个成员国中，瑙鲁是唯一一个对此条款持异议的国家。

body.en:
The Pacific Islands Forum (PIF) has wrapped up with most nations agreeing to "register concern" on China's recent intercontinental ballistic missile (ICBM) test, "which overflew a number of members without adequate notice".

"Leaders call on all states undertaking ICBM testing to ensure transparency and reassurance, including through the provision of advance notification of a test at least 24 hours in accordance with international practice," the communique says, as read out by Palau's President and PIF chair Surangel Whipps Junior, after the closing ceremony.

In a rare move for the usually consensus-based forum, Nauru was the only one of 18 PIF members to dissent from the clause.

Kiribati and Nauru were the only two Pacific nations that had previously blocked a draft PIF statement in the immediate aftermath of Beijing's test, a move that Prime Minister Anthony Albanese had been advocating for.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

However the statement went further than analysts and government sources had expected; the PIF foreign ministers' meeting statement in August was broader, discussing ballistic missile testing in the region, but had stopped short of singling out a particular ICBM or referencing a notice period for nations to undergo any testing.

Whipps also hit back against China's comments that Palau sensationalised its ballistic missile test, saying: "There's no sensationalism, it's just stating the facts."

"The Pacific Islands weren't informed [of the test]. The ones that were informed were informed late, and so I think the message from the forum is clear: that transparency needs to happen."

Intelligence shows the nuclear-capable intercontinental ballistic missile test in July flew over the Philippines, Palau and Micronesia's airspace before landing in the Pacific Ocean.

The response has become something of a litmus test for PIF and its members for their strategic positioning.

The communique's relevant clause includes a reference to the Fiji-led Ocean of Peace declaration made last year, which states the region should be free from coercion and militarisation.

However, it doesn't name China, nor does it use heftier diplomatic language than "concern".

While Australian officials were happy with the agreed statement, it fell short of some pre-retreat expectations, including those of the host, Palau.

"They sent a missile next to French Polynesia, another one next to Tuvalu, crossing over our airspace. They never bothered to tell us that's what's happening," he said.

"I said 'there's a lot of space between Japan and Guam, why don't you send it there? Why does it have to come to the middle of the Pacific when last year we just signed a...
body.zh: 太平洋岛屿论坛（PIF）结束时，大多数国家同意对中国最近的洲际弹道导弹（ICBM）试验“表达关切”，“该试验在没有充分通知的情况下飞越了一些成员国”。 帕劳总统兼太平洋岛国论坛主席苏兰吉尔·惠普斯·儒尼奥尔在闭幕式后宣读的公报称，“领导人呼吁所有进行洲际弹道导弹测试的国家确保透明度和保证，包括根据国际惯例至少提前 24 小时提前通知测试情况”。 对于这个通常以共识为基础的论坛来说，这是一个罕见的举动，瑙鲁是 18 个 PIF 成员中唯一不同意该条款的国家。 基里巴斯和瑙鲁是此前在北京试验后立即阻止PIF声明草案的仅有的两个太平洋国家，此举是总理安东尼·阿尔巴内斯一直倡导的。 您值得信赖的来源，让您了解周围世界的最新动态。直接将免费的每日新闻更新和分析发送到您的收件箱。 然而，该声明超出了分析师和政府消息人士的预期；太平洋岛国论坛外交部长八月份的会议声明范围更广，讨论了该地区的弹道导弹试验，但没有单独指出特定的洲际弹道导弹或提及各国进行任何试验的通知期。 惠普斯还反驳了中国关于帕劳炒作其弹道导弹试验的言论，他说：“没有煽情，只是陈述事实。” “太平洋岛屿没有被告知（这次测试）。那些被告知的人却很晚才被告知，所以我认为论坛传达的信息很明确：需要实现透明度。” 情报显示，7月份进行的具有核能力的洲际弹道导弹试验飞越了菲律宾、帕劳和密克罗尼西亚的领空，然后降落在太平洋上。 这一回应已成为 PIF 及其成员战略定位的试金石。 公报的相关条款包括提及斐济去年发表的《和平海洋宣言》，该宣言指出该地区不应受到胁迫和军事化。 然而，它没有点名中国，也没有使用比“关切”更重的外交语言。 虽然澳大利亚官员对商定的声明感到满意，但它没有达到一些退会前的预期，包括东道主帕劳的预期。 “他们向法属波利尼西亚发射了一枚导弹，又向图瓦卢发射了一枚导弹，飞越了我们的领空。他们从来没有费心告诉我们发生了什么，”他说。 “我说‘日本和关岛之间有很大的空间，你为什么不把它送到那里？为什么它必须来到太平洋中部，去年我们刚刚签署了一份……

reflection.en: The leaders of the Pacific Islands Forum have expressed concern over a recent ICBM test that flew over their territories without sufficient warning. Their call for transparency and advance notification echoes the ancient prophetic vision of a world where such instruments of potential conflict are managed with greater care and consideration for all nations....
reflection.zh: 太平洋岛国论坛的领导人对近期一次未获充分预警便飞越其领土的洲际弹道导弹试验表示关切。他们呼吁提高透明度和提前通知，这呼应了古代先知的异象——一个世界，在那里，潜在冲突的工具能够得到更谨慎的处理，并顾及所有国家。 这一时刻凸显了国家安全利益与地区稳定之间的微妙平衡，敦促在国际事务中走上更加开放和相互保证的道路。

verse.textEn: They will beat their swords into plowshares and their spears into pruning hooks.
verse.textZh: 他们要将刀打成犁头，把枪打成镰刀。

title.en: Reform’s media presenter worked for Chinese state propaganda channel
title.zh: 改革派媒体主持人曾在中国国家宣传频道工作

summary.en: Reform UK's top media presenter, Ray Addison, who hosts the party's podcast and social media campaigns, has worked for a Chinese state propaganda channel within the past year. Addison presented films about Xinjiang province, where China faces accusations of genocide, for state media in September 2025.
summary.zh: 据《卫报》报道，英国改革党（Reform UK）的首席媒体主持人雷·阿迪森（Ray Addison）在过去一年中曾为中国国家宣传频道工作。阿迪森曾于2025年9月为中国官媒制作了关于新疆省的影片，而中国在该地区面临种族灭绝的指控。

Ray Addison, who presents the political party’s in-house podcast and social media campaigns, fronted films about Xinjiang province – where the Chinese government is accused of committing genocide – for state media in September 2025. reflection.en: The news that a political party's media presenter has worked for a state propaganda channel raises questions about truthfulness and integrity in public communication. Ephesians 4:25 calls believers to "put off falsehood and speak truthfully to one another," a principle vital for maintaining trust in political discourse and media.
reflection.zh: 一名政党媒体主持人曾为国家宣传频道工作的消息，引发了关于公共传播中真实性和诚信的疑问。以弗所书4章25节呼吁信徒“各人与邻舍说实话”，这一原则对于在政治言论和媒体中维持信任至关重要。

verse.textZh: 所以你们要弃绝谎言，各人与邻舍说实话。

title.en: Malaysia's middle path between China and US faces new tests
title.zh: 马来西亚在中国和美国之间走中间道路面临新考验

summary.en: Malaysia's Prime Minister Anwar Ibrahim's recent comments on Taiwan and US-backed military facilities have raised questions about the sustainability of the nation's non-aligned foreign policy as US-China rivalry intensifies in Southeast Asia.
summary.zh: 马来西亚总理安瓦尔·易卜拉欣最近就台湾和美国支持的军事设施发表的言论，在美中竞争日益加剧的东南亚地区，引发了对该国不结盟外交政策可持续性的质疑。

body.en:
The prime minister's comments on Taiwan and US-backed military facilities near Sabah have revived questions over Malaysia's non-aligned foreign policy.

Malaysian Prime Minister Anwar Ibrahim has spent much of his time in office insisting that Kuala Lumpur will not be forced to choose between the United States and China .

But two sets of comments last month have raised questions about how sustainable that position is as rivalry between the two superpowers increasingly spills into Southeast Asia.

"I see Taiwan as part of China, period," he said in an interview with news outlet Al Jazeera that aired on August 16.

Beijing considers democratically governed  Taiwan part of its territory. While Chinese leaders say they favor "peaceful reunification," they have never ruled out using force to bring the island under Beijing's control.

More controversially, Anwar appeared to accept Beijing's argument that force could be necessary.

"If one province decides to break away. Do we use force? I think I will, [to] protect the sanctity and unity of the nation," he said.

The comments drew an enthusiastic response from Beijing, while Taiwan's Foreign Ministry accused Anwar of effectively legitimizing the use of force against the island and warned that his "one-sided support for China could negatively impact Taiwanese businesses' confidence in investing in Malaysia," including in the country's strategically important semiconductor sector.

Two days after his comments on Taiwan aired, Anwar argued that Malaysia  should strengthen its defenses in Sabah, citing the expansion of US-backed military facilities on the nearby Philippine island of Balabac.

The Philippines is upgrading facilities on Balabac, roughly 50 kilometers (31 miles) from the Malaysian islands of Banggi and Balambangan.

Balabac was one of four additional locations added in 2023 to the Enhanced Defense Cooperation Agreement, which allows US forces to access designated Philippine military facilities, construct infrastructure and pre-position equipment.

Taken together, Anwar's comments raised concerns that Malaysia is growing warmer toward Beijing while becoming more suspicious of Washington's military footprint in the region.

Kuala Lumpur has also been one of the region's strongest critics of Israel's actions in Gaza . Anwar has repeatedly accused the United States and European governments of hypocrisy and double standards for championing democracy and international law while failing, in his view, to hold Israel sufficiently accountable.

But Malaysia experts warn against interpreting Anwar's rhetoric as evidence of a fundamental strategic realignment.

"Malaysia still maintains very good relations with the US and other Western countries," Ngeow Chow Bing, director of the Institute...
body.zh: 总理对台湾和沙巴附近美国支持的军事设施的评论再次引发了对马来西亚不结盟外交政策的质疑。 马来西亚总理安瓦尔·易卜拉欣(Anwar Ibrahim)在任期间大部分时间都坚称，吉隆坡不会被迫在美国和中国之间做出选择。 但上个月的两套评论引发了人们的疑问，随着两个超级大国之间的竞争日益蔓延到东南亚，这一立场的可持续性如何。 “我认为台湾是中国的一部分，就这样，”他在接受半岛电视台 8 月 16 日播出的采访时说道。 北京认为台湾是其领土的一部分，实行民主治理。尽管中国领导人表示支持“和平统一”，但他们从未排除使用武力将该岛置于北京的控制之下。 更具争议性的是，安瓦尔似乎接受了北京关于可能需要使用武力的论点。 “如果一个省决定脱离。我们会使用武力吗？我想我会，[以]保护国家的神圣和统一，”他说。 这些言论引起了北京的热烈回应，而台湾外交部则指责安瓦尔实际上使对台湾使用武力合法化，并警告说，他“对中国的片面支持可能会对台湾企业投资马来西亚的信心产生负面影响”，包括对该国具有重要战略意义的半导体行业的投资。 在发表有关台湾的言论两天后，安瓦尔认为马来西亚应该加强在沙巴的防御，并列举了美国支持的在附近的菲律宾巴拉巴克岛扩建军事设施的情况。 菲律宾正在升级巴拉巴克岛的设施，该岛距离马来西亚班吉岛和巴兰班安岛约 50 公里（31 英里）。 巴拉巴克是 2023 年《增强防务合作协议》新增的四个地点之一，该协议允许美军进入菲律宾指定军事设施、建设基础设施和预置设备。 总而言之，安瓦尔的言论引发了人们的担忧，即马来西亚对北京的态度越来越好，同时对华盛顿在该地区的军事足迹越来越怀疑。 吉隆坡也是该地区对以色列在加沙行动最强烈的批评者之一。安瓦尔一再指责美国和欧洲政府在倡导民主和国际法方面虚伪和双重标准，同时他认为，未能让以色列承担足够的责任。 但马来西亚专家警告不要将安瓦尔的言论解读为根本战略调整的证据。 “马来西亚仍然与美国和其他西方国家保持着非常良好的关系，”该中心主任Ngeow Chow Bing...

reflection.en: Malaysia's Prime Minister Anwar Ibrahim seeks to navigate a delicate path between global powers, aiming to avoid choosing sides. This pursuit of balance reflects a desire for peace and stability in a complex geopolitical landscape. The challenge lies in upholding this 'middle path' when external pressures mount, testing the nation's resolve to foster good...
reflection.zh: 马来西亚总理安瓦尔·易卜拉欣试图在两大全球势力之间走一条微妙的道路，力求不选边站队。这种寻求平衡的努力，反映了在复杂的地缘政治格局中对和平与稳定的渴望。当外部压力增大时，如何坚持这条“中间道路”并促进与各方的良好关系，是对国家决心的考验。

verse.textEn: If it is possible, as far as it depends on you, live at peace with everyone.
verse.textZh: 若是能行，总要尽力与众人和睦。

title.en: Dozens of trapped hydropower tunnel workers in Nepal could still be alive, official says
title.zh: 尼泊尔水电隧道数十名被困工人仍有可能活着，官员称

summary.en: Approximately 46 workers are believed to be trapped in a 'room-like' structure within a hydropower plant tunnel on the Nepal-Tibet border following deadly flash floods. A Nepal electricity authority official expressed hope that many could still be found alive after a week.
summary.zh: 在致命的山洪暴发后，约有46名工人被认为被困在尼泊尔-西藏边境水电站隧道内的一个“房间状”结构中。尼泊尔电力局的一名官员表示，希望许多人在一周后仍能被发现活着。

body.en: About 46 people believed to be trapped in ‘room-like’ structure inside hydro plant tunnel on Nepal-Tibet border After the flood: human suffering on an unfathomable scale in Nepal’s worst-hit districts Nepal authorities have said they are “confident” that dozens of workers in Nepal’s Rasuwagadhi hydropower plant are still alive, more than a week after deadly flash floods left them trapped in an underground chamber. Authorities said that at least 639 workers were still missing from hydropower plants built along Nepal’s Bhote Koshi and Triushuli rivers. Continue reading...
body.zh: 尼泊尔与西藏边境的水电站隧道内约有 46 人被困在“类似房间”的结构中 洪水过后：尼泊尔受灾最严重的地区的人们遭受了难以估量的痛苦 一名尼泊尔电力局官员表示，在致命的山洪爆发后，数十名工人被困在尼泊尔拉苏瓦加迪水电站的地下密室中一周后，很可能会发现数十名工人还活着。尼泊尔电力局董事会成员阿姆苏·基兰·沙希 (Amhsu Kiran Shahi) 周三对路透社表示：“在拉苏瓦加迪，我们认为有 46 人被困在隧道内一个类似房间的结构中。”继续阅读...

reflection.en: In the face of disaster, the immediate concern is for the lives of those trapped. Amidst the uncertainty and fear, there is a flicker of hope that these 46 workers might still be found alive. This situation calls to mind Psalm 46:1, reminding us that even in overwhelming crises, God is our refuge and strength.
reflection.zh: 面对灾难，当务之急是那些被困者的生命。在不确定和恐惧之中，人们怀着一丝希望，希望这46名工人仍能被活着找到。这种情况让人想起诗篇46:1，提醒我们即使在压倒性的危机中，雅伟也是我们的避难所和力量。

verse.textEn: God is our refuge and strength, an ever-present help in trouble.
verse.textZh: 神是我们的避难所，是我们的力量，是我们在患难中随时的帮助。

title.en: Can communities be proteced from melting glaciers?
title.zh: 社区能否免受冰川融化的影响？

summary.en: Rising temperatures are increasing the risk of floods and avalanches in mountain regions. The disaster in Nepal and Tibet shows the urgent need for solutions, and the tools that could help save lives.
summary.zh: 日益升高的气温增加了山区发生洪水和雪崩的风险。尼泊尔和西藏的灾难表明，迫切需要解决方案以及可能有助于挽救生命的工具。

body.en:
Rising temperatures are increasing the risk of floods and avalanches in mountain regions. The disaster in Nepal and Tibet shows the urgent need for solutions, and the tools that could help save lives.

High mountain glaciers formed in the ice age are retreating and becoming unstable as the burning of fossil fuels heats the climate and leads to a decline in snowfall.

The instability creates the conditions for large glacial sections to collapse, triggering ice and rock avalanches that can dam river valleys before tidal waves of water are released.

Following the glacier collapse that triggered what is known as a mountain tsunami in Nepal and Tibet on August 26 , thousands are still missing and feared dead. Unlike the 2025 glacier avalanche that destroyed the town of Blatten in Switzerland — where nearly all inhabitants were evacuated — a lack of early warning systems in the Himalayas left locals and tourists at the mercy of flash floods .

The causes of glacier collapse are part of a complex web of interrelated changes to high mountain landscapes due in part to rising global temperatures, say scientists.

Levan Tielidze, research fellow in glacial geomorphology at Australia's Monash University, said the Himalayas are not, as is often imagined, a "frozen and relatively stable environment," but "dynamic systems in which glaciers , snow, permafrost, rock slopes, rivers and monsoon processes interact." 

"As the climate warms, these components are changing simultaneously, meaning hazards can cascade from one process into another," he told DW. When rock, ice and water interact in more unpredictable ways on the world's highest peaks, the resulting debris flows "can transform into a catastrophic flood far downstream."

Almost 25 years ago, in what was then the biggest glacial collapse in history, one glacier crashed onto another in the Caucasus Mountains of North Ossetia in Russia. The event caused avalanches of ice and debris that slid more than 24 kilometers (15 miles) and killed around 125 people.

"The Kolka Glacier disaster was one of the early warnings of the increasing occurrence and potential severity of such glacier-related hazards," said Tielidze. 

Meanwhile, the UN says glaciers in Nepalese mountains have declined by one-third in 30 years, which has added to their instability. 

Some research suggests that even if emissions from burning fossil fuels were low enough to prevent the planet from heating by more than 2 degrees Celsius (3.6 Fahrenheit) compared to pre-industrial times, the wider Hindu Kush Himalayan region could lose up to half its glacier cover — compared to 2020 levels — by the end of the century.

For Dipesh Chapagain, senior scientist at...
body.zh: 气温上升增加了山区发生洪水和雪崩的风险。尼泊尔和西藏的灾难表明迫切需要解决方案以及可以帮助拯救生命的工具。 由于化石燃料的燃烧导致气候变暖并导致降雪量减少，冰河时代形成的高山冰川正在后退并变得不稳定。 这种不稳定性为大片冰川崩塌创造了条件，引发冰雪崩塌，在潮水释放之前可能会堵塞河谷。 8 月 26 日，冰川崩塌在尼泊尔和西藏引发了山地海啸，之后仍有数千人失踪并恐已死亡。与 2025 年摧毁瑞士布拉滕镇的冰川雪崩不同，那次冰川雪崩几乎所有居民都被疏散，喜马拉雅山缺乏预警系统，导致当地人和游客受到山洪暴发的影响。 科学家表示，冰川崩塌的原因是高山景观相互关联的复杂变化网络的一部分，部分原因是全球气温上升。 澳大利亚莫纳什大学冰川地貌学研究员莱万·蒂利泽 (Levan Tielidze) 表示，喜马拉雅山并不像人们通常想象的那样是一个“冰冻且相对稳定的环境”，而是“冰川、积雪、永久冻土、岩坡、河流和季风过程相互作用的动态系统”。 他告诉德国之声：“随着气候变暖，这些组成部分同时发生变化，这意味着危害可能从一个过程级联到另一个过程。” 当岩石、冰和水在世界最高峰上以更难以预测的方式相互作用时，由此产生的泥石流“可能会在下游转化为灾难性的洪水”。 大约 25 年前，俄罗斯北奥塞梯高加索山脉的一座冰川与另一座冰川相撞，发生了当时历史上最严重的冰川崩塌事件。该事件导致冰雪和碎片滑落超过 24 公里（15 英里），造成约 125 人死亡。 蒂利泽说：“科尔卡冰川灾难是此类冰川相关灾害日益频繁且潜在严重性的早期预警之一。” 与此同时，联合国表示，尼泊尔山区的冰川在 30 年内减少了三分之一，这加剧了冰川的不稳定。 一些研究表明，即使燃烧化石燃料的排放量足够低，足以防止地球升温超过工业化前时期 2 摄氏度（3.6 华氏度），到本世纪末，更广阔的兴都库什喜马拉雅地区的冰川覆盖率可能会比 2020 年的水平减少多达一半。 对于 Dipesh Chapagagain 来说，高级科学家......

reflection.en: The melting glaciers and subsequent disasters in Nepal and Tibet are a stark reminder that our planet groans under the weight of human activity. Romans 8:22 speaks of all creation groaning in travail, awaiting its redemption. This passage calls us to acknowledge the deep interconnectedness of our world and our responsibility to care for it.
reflection.zh: 尼泊尔和西藏融化的冰川及随之而来的灾难，鲜明地提醒我们，我们的地球在人类活动的重压下呻吟。罗马书8:22说，万物一同叹息劳苦，等候得赎。这段经文呼吁我们认识到我们世界深层的相互联系，以及我们照顾它的责任。

verse.textEn: We know that the whole creation has been groaning as in the pains of childbirth right up to the present time.
verse.textZh: 我们知道，一切受造之物一同叹息、劳苦，直到如今。

title.en: How China buried Tibet flood images after Nepal disaster
title.zh: 中国如何掩埋了尼泊尔灾难后的西藏洪水图像

summary.en: In Tibet, a digital crackdown followed the deadly flood that has devastated communities along the China-Nepal border. Censors erased viral footage while Chinese state media flooded platforms with official content.
summary.zh: 在西藏，一场致命的洪水摧毁了中国和尼泊尔边境的社区，随后出现了数字审查。审查人员删除了病毒式传播的画面，而中国官方媒体则用官方内容充斥了各大平台。

body.en:
In Tibet, a digital crackdown followed the deadly flood that has devastated communities along the China-Nepal border. Censors erased viral footage while Chinese state media flooded platforms with official content.

When a catastrophic flash flood swept through the rugged China-Nepal border on August 26, the physical devastation was immediate.

In Nepal , a black torrent of mud and rock tore through communities, leaving hundreds dead and thousands more missing along the borderlands.

But across the frontier in Tibet, an autonomous region of China , the physical disaster was almost instantly followed by a digital one: the rapid, high-tech erasure of the catastrophe's visual evidence.

As survivors tried to upload raw footage of the deluge, China's state-backed information control apparatus swung into action, executing a sophisticated, precision operation to shape the public narrative and bury inconvenient truths.

The contrasting realities — a tragic humanitarian crisis in Nepal and a tightly sanitized, triumphant rescue narrative in China — reveal the evolving mechanics of Beijing's modern censorship machine.

Rather than imposing a blunt, blanket blackout, authorities deployed advanced image-recognition technology and "saturated information" tactics to drown out domestic scrutiny while deflecting diplomatic friction abroad.

In the immediate aftermath of the flood-triggered mudslide, local residents captured dramatic footage of the torrent engulfing Gyirong Port, a critical overland trade hub between China and Nepal.

The most striking video showed a black wall of water and debris crashing into and destroying the "national" border gate.

In an article titled "An Unrecorded Mudslide Rushes into Gyirong Port" on China's WeChat, a universal app that combines messaging with payment options and social media functions, local blogger "Matou Qingnian" described the chaotic scene.

"The most terrifying moment happened at the Gyirong Port," the author wrote, describing video footage of crowds, including children, fleeing in panic before a pitch-black torrent swallowed the camera's view.

Within hours, both the article and the raw video footage had vanished from Chinese social media .

According to  China Digital Times (CDT) , an independent watchdog that tracks Chinese internet censorship , the video of the collapsing border gate was systematically blocked from being shared on WeChat, even in private messages.

"The footage itself contained no graphic violence, no protests, and no political slogans," explained Mira, a CDT editor who specializes in tracking sensitive keywords and media. "The target of the censorship was the symbol itself: the National Gate."

Digital analysts note that this censorship highlights a significant upgrade...
body.zh: 在西藏，致命的洪水摧毁了中尼边境沿线的社区，随后进行了数字镇压。审查机构删除了病毒式传播的视频，而中国官方媒体则在平台上充斥着官方内容。 8 月 26 日，一场灾难性的山洪席卷崎岖的中尼边境，造成了立即的破坏。 在尼泊尔，一股黑色泥浆和岩石洪流席卷了边境地区的社区，造成数百人死亡、数千人失踪。 但在中国西藏自治区的边境地区，这场物理灾难几乎立刻就发生了一场数字灾难：灾难的视觉证据被迅速、高科技删除。 当幸存者试图上传洪水的原始镜头时，中国国家支持的信息控制机构立即采取行动，执行复杂而精确的操作，以塑造公众叙事并掩盖难以忽视的真相。 对比鲜明的现实——尼泊尔悲惨的人道主义危机和中国严密消毒、胜利的救援故事——揭示了北京现代审查机制不断演变的机制。 当局没有实施生硬、全面的封锁，而是采用了先进的图像识别技术和“饱和信息”策略来淹没国内审查，同时转移国外的外交摩擦。 洪水引发的泥石流发生后，当地居民拍下了洪流吞没吉隆港的戏剧性镜头，吉隆港是中国和尼泊尔之间重要的陆路贸易枢纽。 最引人注目的视频显示，黑色的水墙和碎片冲撞并摧毁了“国家”边境大门。 当地博主“马头青年”在中国微信（一款将消息传递、支付选项和社交媒体功能结合在一起的通用应用程序）上发表了一篇题为“一场未记录的泥石流冲进吉隆口岸”的文章，描述了当时的混乱场面。 “最可怕的时刻发生在吉隆口岸，”作者写道，并描述了包括儿童在内的人群在漆黑的洪流吞没摄像机视野之前惊慌失措的画面。 几个小时内，这篇文章和原始视频片段就从中国社交媒体上消失了。 据追踪中国互联网审查制度的独立监管机构中国数字时代（CDT）称，倒塌边境大门的视频被系统性地禁止在微信上分享，甚至在私人信息中也是如此。 专门跟踪敏感关键词和媒体的 CDT 编辑米拉解释说：“视频本身不包含暴力画面、抗议活动和政治口号。” “审查的目标是标志本身：国门。” 数字分析师指出，这次审查凸显了重大升级......

reflection.en: The story describes how visual evidence of a devastating flood in Tibet was systematically erased, replaced by official narratives. This act of censorship raises questions about truth and transparency, reminding us of the importance of speaking truthfully and avoiding deception, as Ephesians 4:25 urges.
reflection.zh: 故事描述了西藏一场毁灭性洪水的视觉证据如何被系统性地抹去，并被官方叙事所取代。这种审查行为引发了关于真相和透明度的疑问，提醒我们说实话和避免欺骗的重要性，正如以弗所书4:25所敦促的那样。

verse.textEn: Therefore each of you must put off falsehood and speak truthfully to your neighbor.
verse.textZh: 所以你们要弃绝谎言，各人与邻舍说实话。

title.en: Where's the snow? Could 2026 be Australia's worst season?
title.zh: 雪在哪里？2026年将是澳大利亚最糟糕的季节吗？

summary.en: Ski resorts across Australia are closing early as snow depth reaches a record low, with the Snowy Mountains' Spencers Creek recording its third-lowest peak depth since 1954.
summary.zh: 澳大利亚的滑雪胜地因降雪量达到创纪录的低点而提前关闭，斯宾塞溪的降雪量自1954年以来达到第三低的峰值。

body.en:
Australian ski resorts are being forced to close a month early due to record-low snow depth.

Snowy Mountain's Spencers Creek hit a historic Australian low, recording a snow depth of 31.2 centimetres on 3 September.

The peak depth was 94.5cm on 13 August — the third lowest depth recorded in the region since 1954.

On average, peak depth is recorded in the first weeks of September. From the 1950s to the 1970s, the average depth in the first week of September was just over 180 centimetres — compared to the 120cm average from 2020 to 2025.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

Deep Creek registered record-high snow depths of over 200cm in 1964 and 1981, while Three Mile Dam had record-highs just over 100cm in 1956 and 1995.

The 2026 ski season was the shortest on record, with five of Australia's ski resorts already shutting the slopes.

Victoria's Mount Baw Baw and Selwyn Snow Resort in NSW closed operations before the end of August — with Mt Hotham, Falls Creek and Charlotte Pass closing over the weekend.

Only three of the eight mainland ski resorts in Australia remain open — Perisher, Thredbo and Mount Buller.

Ski season's premature end can be chalked up to the winter warmth and a lack of snow-bearing cold fronts.

The unusual winter warmth can be attributed to a multitude of weather behaviours, including El Niño, above-average sea surface temperatures, limited cold air in frontal systems and the ongoing impacts of climate change.

Australian Climate Council councillor and meteorologist Dr Andrew Watkins told SBS News in May it would be a warm winter.

For the latest from SBS News, download our app and subscribe to our newsletter .
body.zh: 由于积雪深度创历史新低，澳大利亚滑雪胜地被迫提前一个月关闭。 9 月 3 日，雪山的 Spencers Creek 降雪深度达到澳大利亚历史最低点，达到 31.2 厘米。 8 月 13 日的峰值深度为 94.5 厘米，这是该地区自 1954 年以来有记录的第三低深度。 平均而言，峰值深度出现在九月的第一周。从 20 世纪 50 年代到 1970 年代，9 月第一周的平均深度略高于 180 厘米，而 2020 年到 2025 年的平均深度为 120 厘米。 您值得信赖的来源，让您了解周围世界的最新动态。直接将免费的每日新闻更新和分析发送到您的收件箱。 深溪在 1964 年和 1981 年创下了超过 200 厘米的历史最高积雪深度，而三英里大坝在 1956 年和 1995 年创下了略高于 100 厘米的历史最高积雪深度。 2026 年的滑雪季节是有记录以来最短的，澳大利亚的五个滑雪胜地已经关闭了滑雪场。 新南威尔士州维多利亚州的 Mount Baw Baw 和 Selwyn 滑雪度假村已于 8 月底前关闭，霍瑟姆山 (Mt Hotham)、福尔斯克里克 (Falls Creek) 和夏洛特山口 (Charlotte Pass) 也在周末关闭。 澳大利亚八个大陆滑雪胜地中只有三个仍然开放：Perisher、Thredbo 和 Mount Buller。 滑雪季节的提前结束可以归因于冬季温暖和缺乏带雪的冷锋。 冬季异常温暖可归因于多种天气行为，包括厄尔尼诺现象、高于平均水平的海面温度、锋面系统冷空气有限以及气候变化的持续影响。 澳大利亚气候委员会委员兼气象学家安德鲁·沃特金斯博士在五月告诉 SBS 新闻，这将是一个温暖的冬天。 如需了解 SBS 新闻的最新动态，请下载我们的应用程序并订阅我们的时事通讯。

reflection.en: The news from Australia's ski fields paints a stark picture of environmental change impacting livelihoods. Even when the usual abundance of winter is absent, and the land yields little, there remains a call to find joy and steadfastness. This season's scarcity reminds us that our ultimate hope is not in predictable seasons, but in the enduring faithfulness...
reflection.zh: 澳大利亚滑雪场的新闻描绘了一幅严峻的环境变化影响生计的图景。即使在冬季的丰饶不再、土地产量甚少之时，仍有呼召去寻找喜乐和坚定。这个季节的匮乏提醒我们，我们最终的盼望不在于可预测的季节，而在于雅伟永恒的信实。

verse.textEn: Though the fig tree does not bud and there are no grapes on the vines... yet I will rejoice in Yahweh.
verse.textZh: 虽然无花果树不发旺，葡萄树不结果……然而，我要因雅伟欢欣。

title.en: Sydney reaches 33C in potentially warmest start to spring since mid-1800s, while snow forecast in southern NSW
title.zh: 悉尼春季开局或迎1850年代以来最暖天气，南部新州却预报降雪

summary.en: Sydney is bracing for its warmest spring start since the mid-1800s, with temperatures expected to reach 33C and a total fire ban in place due to extreme fire danger exacerbated by hot and windy conditions. This contrasts with forecasts of snow in southern New South Wales, highlighting unusual weather patterns across...
summary.zh: 悉尼正准备迎接自19世纪中叶以来最温暖的春季开端，气温预计将达到33摄氏度，并因炎热多风的天气加剧了极端火灾危险，已实施全面禁火令。这与新南威尔士州南部预测的降雪形成鲜明对比，凸显了澳大利亚东部不同寻常的天气模式。

body.en: A total fire ban is in place for greater Sydney with extreme fire danger exacerbated by hot and windy conditions Get our breaking news email , free app or daily news podcast Summer heat is due to arrive early across much of eastern Australia with potentially record early September temperatures predicted for Brisbane and Sydney, while snow was expected in southern New South Wales. Maximum temperatures in Sydney during the first days of September were on track to match the city’s midsummer average of 26.4C, warmer than any other start to spring since the city’s Observatory Hill station opened in 1858. Continue reading...
body.zh: 大悉尼地区已实施全面禁火令，炎热多风的天气会加剧极端火灾危险 获取我们的突发新闻电子邮件、免费应用程序或每日新闻播客 澳大利亚东部大部分地区将提前迎来夏季高温，预计布里斯班和悉尼 9 月初气温可能创历史新高，而新南威尔士州南部预计将下雪。悉尼 9 月初的最高气温有望与该市仲夏平均气温 26.4 摄氏度相匹配，这是自 1858 年该市天文台山站启用以来任何其他春季开始时都温暖的温度。继续阅读...

reflection.en: As Sydney faces unprecedented early spring heat, leading to extreme fire danger, we are reminded that this Earth, with all its varied climates and seasons, is ultimately Yahweh's. The intense heat and the contrasting snow forecast across regions call us to reflect on our role as stewards of creation, tending to it with wisdom and care.
reflection.zh: 当悉尼面临前所未有的初春高温，导致极端火灾危险时，我们被提醒，这片大地及其万有，连同其多样的气候和季节，最终都属于雅伟。这种酷热以及跨区域的降雪预报，促使我们反思作为受造之物的管家，应如何以智慧和关怀来照料这片土地。

verse.textEn: The earth is Yahweh's, and everything in it, the world, and all who live in it.
verse.textZh: 地和其中所充满的，世界和住在其间的，都属雅伟。

title.en: 'Australia is for all of us': Socceroos star on his Pauline Hanson rebuff
title.zh: 袋鼠队球星再次回绝保琳·汉森，透露重返澳超联赛的原因

summary.en: Socceroos star Awer Mabil is making a return to the A-League as conversations over multiculturalism swirl.
summary.zh: 袋鼠队球星阿维尔·马比尔（Awer Mabil）在关于多元文化主义的讨论甚嚣尘上之际，正重返澳超联赛。

body.en:
Awer Mabil was 10 years old when he moved to Australia, and by the time he was 19, his skills with a football took him to Europe.

Now at 30, Mabil has decided to repeat the pattern and return to Australia once more.

Mabil decided his 11 years away, lonely at times, were enough and signed a three-year contract with Melbourne City FC in early August.

The former refugee's return comes as tension over immigration and multiculturalism mounts.

The Socceroos winger has said he’s not really politically engaged, but during the World Cup he was an outspoken critic of Pauline Hanson’s comments.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

Speaking after returning home to Adelaide after Australia was dumped out of the tournament , Mabil was asked by a reporter if the One Nation leader's remarks about Australia needing to be a monocultural society had been a distraction to the team and asked about suggestions that Australia was not a multicultural country.

"It's just all bullshit," he replied, also stating "Australia is the best country in the world".

Mabil had limited playing time at the World Cup; however, he scored his penalty during Australia’s shootout loss to Egypt in the Round of 32.

Now, months after the tournament, Mabil has spoken to SBS, insisting he hasn't been following the ins and outs of Australia's migration debate, but that he was prepared to speak out against Hanson again now and would continue to do so.

He believes "Australia is for all of us", and that he wants "safety and peace for everybody no matter where they come from".

He said that Socceroos players "would all defend Australia at any given time ... if there was war tomorrow, I think we'll all roll up our sleeves and fight for Australia together".

The Socceroos squad at the World Cup reflected at least 15 cultural and ethnic backgrounds and included four former refugees.

He played for a spread of European clubs including Kasımpaşa in Türkiye, FC Midtjylland in Denmark and Spanish clubs Cádiz CF and CD Castellón.

While he was away, he says Australia's A-League was developing in leaps and bounds.

When Melbourne City presented their ambitions and plans to Mabil, he thought it was "perfect timing" and that he was "at a good age to also help the club".

He’s also very excited to be close to family again for support, having spent 13 years as a professional, including two years in Adelaide as a teenager .

"I can be playing week in, week out in front of my family and my friends," he said.

"I've had a few visits from the family members here. So that was not an everyday thing before in Europe, but now that I'm here, they can just be here...
body.zh: Awer Mabil 10 岁时移居澳大利亚，19 岁时，他的足球技能将他带到了欧洲。 现年 30 岁的 Mabil 决定重复这一模式，再次返回澳大利亚。 马比尔觉得自己离开 11 年、有时感到孤独已经足够了，并于 8 月初与墨尔本城足球俱乐部签订了一份为期三年的合同。 这位前难民的回归正值移民和多元文化主义紧张局势加剧之际。 这位澳大利亚边锋表示，他并没有真正参与政治，但在世界杯期间，他直言不讳地批评了宝琳·汉森的言论。 您值得信赖的来源，让您了解周围世界的最新动态。直接将免费的每日新闻更新和分析发送到您的收件箱。 澳大利亚被淘汰出比赛后返回阿德莱德后，马比尔被一名记者问到，一国党领导人关于澳大利亚需要成为单一文化社会的言论是否分散了球队的注意力，并询问了关于澳大利亚不是一个多元文化国家的建议。 “这都是废话，”他回答道，并表示“澳大利亚是世界上最好的国家”。 马比尔在世界杯上的出场时间有限；然而，他在32强赛澳大利亚点球大战输给埃及的比赛中罚进了点球。 现在，比赛结束几个月后，马比尔接受了 SBS 采访，坚称他并没有关注澳大利亚移民辩论的来龙去脉，但他现在准备再次公开反对汉森，并将继续这样做。 他相信“澳大利亚适合我们所有人”，并且他希望“每个人都享有安全与和平，无论他们来自哪里”。 他说，澳大利亚队球员“在任何特定时间都会保卫澳大利亚……如果明天发生战争，我想我们都会卷起袖子，一起为澳大利亚而战”。 参加世界杯的澳大利亚队代表了至少 15 种文化和种族背景，其中包括四名前难民。 他曾效力于多家欧洲俱乐部，包括土耳其的 Kasımpaşa、丹麦的 FC Midtjylland 以及西班牙俱乐部 Cádiz CF 和 CD Castellón。 他说，在他离开期间，澳大利亚的甲级联赛正在突飞猛进地发展。 当墨尔本城向马比尔提出他们的雄心和计划时，他认为这是“完美的时机”，而且他“也正处于帮助俱乐部的好年纪”。 他也非常高兴能够再次与家人亲近并获得支持，他已经成为一名职业球员 13 年，其中青少年时期在阿德莱德度过了两年。 “我可以一周又一周地在家人和朋友面前打球，”他说。 “我的家人来过这里几次。所以这在欧洲以前并不是一件平常的事情，但现在我在这里，他们就可以在这里......

His journey from displacement to professional sports, and his willingness to engage in conversations about multiculturalism, highlights the strength and perspective that immigrants bring to a nation. His voice, shaped by experience, adds to the important dialogue about...
reflection.zh: 阿维尔·马比尔（Awer Mabil）作为一名难民来到澳大利亚，现在他将重返澳超联赛踢球。他从流离失所到成为职业运动员的经历，以及他愿意参与关于多元文化主义的对话，都彰显了移民为国家带来的力量和视角。他那饱经世事的嗓音，为关于澳大利亚的归属感和身份认同的重要对话增添了价值。

verse.textEn: Speak up for those who cannot speak for themselves, for the rights of all who are destitute. Speak up and judge fairly; defend the rights of the poor and needy.

title.en: Rescue of Nepal hydropower workers ‘triumph for humans and humanity’, tunnelling expert says

reflection.en: Amidst the devastation of flash floods in Nepal, the survival of two workers pulled alive from a flooded tunnel after nine days offers a powerful testament to human resilience. This remarkable rescue, described as a triumph, reminds us that even in the face of immense suffering and loss, hope can emerge, and the human spirit can endure.
reflection.zh: 在尼泊尔洪水肆虐的灾难中，两名工人在被困九天后获救生还，这有力地证明了人类的韧性。这次非凡的救援被誉为一次胜利，它提醒我们，即使面对巨大的痛苦和损失，希望依然能够出现，人类的精神也能够承受。

verse.textEn: We also glory in our sufferings, because we know that suffering produces perseverance; perseverance, character; and character, hope.
verse.textZh: 就是在患难中也是欢欢喜喜的；因为知道患难生忍耐，忍耐生老练，老练生盼望。

title.en: The climate question following Albanese from Palau to New York
title.zh: 阿尔巴尼斯从帕劳到纽约的气候问题

summary.en: The Australian government has supported the expansion of two new coal and gas projects in the midst of crucial climate change talks.
summary.zh: 在关键的气候变化谈判中，澳大利亚政府支持了两个新的煤炭和天然气项目的扩张。

body.en:
Prime Minister Anthony Albanese's efforts to strengthen Pacific ties and influence the world at the United Nations could be compromised by Australia's failure to meet climate change commitments, critics have warned.

Albanese attended the Pacific Islands Forum (PIF) in Palau this week, preparing for an Australian-organised climate meeting to be held in Fiji and Tuvalu next month.

The event will take place ahead of the United Nations' climate change conference, COP31, which will be held in Antalya, Türkiye in November.

The meeting, an outcome of Australia's failed bid to host COP31 , will include representatives from Antigua and Barbuda, Cabo Verde, Thailand, Maldives, Timor-Leste, Germany, Mexico and South Korea — and focus on the realities of climate change for the Pacific Islands.

During a press conference in Palau this week, Albanese was questioned about the value of the pre-COP31 event, given the low attendance among non-Pacific Islander leaders.

He accused the journalist of being "so disrespectful" to Pacific leaders present.

"It's about bringing Pacific frontline experience to the centre of global deliberations," he said.

"We need to actually have some respect for the process and respect for our Pacific leaders — and Australia has an absolute interest in engaging with the Pacific."

Albanese's attendance at this year's PIF is the start of a string of international events on his calendar, including the UN General Assembly in New York.

Albanese will address the UNGA on 24 September in a bid to secure a non-permanent place on the UN Security Council in 2029-30.

"A seat on the Security Council would give Australia a stronger voice in the decisions that affect our region," Foreign Minister Penny Wong said.

Wesley Morgan, Australian Climate Council fellow and senior research associate at the UNSW's Institute of Climate Risk and Response, said climate change is the "single greatest threat" to the Pacific Islands.

"When it was first raised at the UN Security Council 20 years ago, Pacific countries said climate change is what guns and bombs are to other nations," Morgan said.

He said the key to Australia becoming the region's "security partner of choice" is proper action on climate change.

In 2022, Solomon Islands signed a security deal with China — an act that got "alarm bells ringing in Canberra", Morgan said.

This was the catalyst for Australia signing bilateral agreements with Tuvalu, Naoero, Papua New Guinea, Vanuatu and Fiji.

body.zh: 批评人士警告说，澳大利亚未能履行气候变化承诺，可能会损害澳大利亚总理安东尼·阿尔巴内塞在联合国加强太平洋关系和影响世界的努力。 阿尔巴尼斯本周出席了在帕劳举行的太平洋岛屿论坛（PIF），为下个月在斐济和图瓦卢举行的澳大利亚组织的气候会议做准备。 该活动将在联合国气候变化大会 COP31 之前举行，该会议将于 11 月在土耳其安塔利亚举行。 这次会议是澳大利亚申办 COP31 失败的结果，会议将包括来自安提瓜和巴布达、佛得角、泰国、马尔代夫、东帝汶、德国、墨西哥和韩国的代表，重点讨论太平洋岛屿气候变化的现实。 本周在帕劳举行的新闻发布会上，鉴于非太平洋岛民领导人出席率较低，Albanese 被问及 COP31 前活动的价值。 您值得信赖的来源，让您了解周围世界的最新动态。直接将免费的每日新闻更新和分析发送到您的收件箱。 他指责这名记者对在场的太平洋领导人“非常不尊重”。 “这是为了将太平洋前线的经验带到全球审议的中心，”他说。 “我们实际上需要尊重这一进程，尊重我们的太平洋领导人——澳大利亚对与太平洋地区的接触有着绝对的兴趣。” Albanese 出席今年的 PIF 是他日程上一系列国际活动的开始，其中包括在纽约举行的联合国大会。 阿尔巴内塞将于 9 月 24 日在联合国大会上发表讲话，争取在 2029-30 年度获得联合国安理会非常任理事国席位。 外交部长黄英贤表示：“在安理会获得席位将使澳大利亚在影响我们地区的决策中拥有更强的发言权。” 澳大利亚气候委员会研究员、新南威尔士大学气候风险与应对研究所高级研究员韦斯利·摩根表示，气候变化是太平洋岛屿面临的“最大威胁”。 “20年前，当太平洋国家首次在联合国安理会提出这一问题时，太平洋国家表示，气候变化对于其他国家来说就像枪支和炸弹一样，”摩根说。 他表示，澳大利亚成为该地区“首选安全伙伴”的关键是对气候变化采取适当行动。 摩根表示，2022 年，所罗门群岛与中国签署了一项安全协议，这一行为“给堪培拉敲响了警钟”。 这是澳大利亚与图瓦卢、纳奥罗、巴布亚新几内亚、瓦努阿图和斐济签署双边协议的催化剂。 他说，阻止澳大利亚履行这些协议的原因是它是世界上最大的煤炭和天然气出口国之一，而且出口......

verse.textEn: The earth is Yahweh's, and everything in it, the world, and all who live in it.
