title.en: Why the 'great Aussie summer' may become a thing of the past
title.zh: 为什么“伟大的澳大利亚夏天”可能成为过去

summary.en: Should we schedule our 'peak' summer — holidays, school breaks and sporting events — according to safety rather than tradition? Last summer, Paris Brooke watched in horror as a bushfire blazed through the national park across the lake from her township of Mallacoota in north-east Victoria. The exodus was reminiscent...
summary.zh: 我们是否应该根据安全而不是传统来安排我们的“高峰”夏季——假期、学校休息和体育赛事？去年夏天，巴黎·布鲁克惊恐地看着一场丛林大火在她家乡维多利亚州东北部马拉库塔镇对面的湖泊上燃烧。这次撤离让人想起 2019-20 年夏天，澳大利亚的“黑色夏天”丛林大火席卷并摧毁了这个海滨小镇。马拉库塔是受灾最严重的地区之一。

body.en:
Last summer, Paris Brooke watched in horror as a bushfire blazed through the national park across the lake from her township of Mallacoota in north-east Victoria.

"The camp park emptied out overnight, leaving businesses that depend on summer tourism stuck with unused supplies and staff, but no more tourists," Brooke tells SBS News.

The exodus was reminiscent of the summer of 2019-20, when Australia's Black Summer bushfires swept through and devastated the beachside town.

Mallacoota was among the hardest-hit areas . Apocalyptic-looking scenes of residents and holidaymakers sheltering in boats off the coast, under a red sky thick with smoke, were broadcast around the world.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

While Brooke hasn't necessarily seen a slowdown in holidaymakers to the town since, she believes stays are shortening and worries the increased likelihood of extreme weather will hit summer trade long-term.

It's why she set up the Wilderness Collective, a community not-for-profit aimed at helping locals build new skills and businesses to reduce reliance on summer tourism.

"People are much more aware of natural disasters such as bushfires or droughts," she says.

On the same day last summer, climate scientist Linden Ashcroft was on the beach in Mallacoota. She recalls her kids playing in the water as embers and burnt leaves fell around them.

"It was pretty heartbreaking and terrifying. Everyone was really creeped out, and the town was covered in smoke," she says.

It left her with a lasting sense of cognitive dissonance — this is not how summer is supposed to feel.

That feeling is now rippling around the country, reaching far beyond places like Mallacoota that are historically prone to bushfires.

"Black Summer 2019–2020 was a real step change; it made people face the reality that summer can't just be carefree anymore," Ashcroft says.

Climate Council director and academic Lesley Hughes says the changing climate is reshaping Australians' notion of summer: instead of looking forward to it, people increasingly feel apprehensive.

"They dread the heatwaves, the bushfires, not being able to do the things they used to. Climate change is stealing the part of the year Australians looked forward to most."

With higher temperatures and more extreme weather events becoming a fixture of the holiday season in parts of the country, could this signal the end of 'great Aussie summer'?

Australia is now 1.5C warmer on average than it was a century ago, according to the National Climate Risk Assessment. It's driving more extreme heatwaves and dangerous fire weather.

Monash climate scientist Andrew Watkins, former head of the Bureau of...
body.zh: 去年夏天，帕丽斯·布鲁克惊恐地看到一场丛林大火席卷了维多利亚州东北部马拉库塔镇与湖对岸的国家公园。 布鲁克告诉 SBS 新闻：“营地公园一夜之间就空了，依赖夏季旅游业的企业陷入了闲置的物资和员工困境，但没有更多的游客。” 这种逃亡让人想起2019-20年夏天，当时澳大利亚的黑夏丛林大火席卷并摧毁了这座海滨小镇。 马拉库塔是受灾最严重的地区之一。世界各地都在播放着世界末日般的场景，居民和度假者在浓烟滚滚的红色天空下，在海岸附近的船上避难。 您值得信赖的来源，让您了解周围世界的最新动态。直接将免费的每日新闻更新和分析发送到您的收件箱。 虽然布鲁克此后并没有看到到该镇度假的人数有所减少，但她认为停留时间正在缩短，并担心极端天气可能性的增加将长期影响夏季贸易。 这就是为什么她成立了 Wilderness Collective，这是一个非营利性社区，旨在帮助当地人培养新技能和开展业务，以减少对夏季旅游的依赖。 “人们对森林大火或干旱等自然灾害有了更多的认识，”她说。 去年夏天的同一天，气候科学家林登·阿什克罗夫特在马拉库塔的海滩上。她回忆起孩子们在水里玩耍时，余烬和烧焦的树叶落在他们周围。 “这真是令人心碎和可怕。每个人都吓坏了，整个城镇都笼罩在烟雾中，”她说。 这给她留下了一种持久的认知失调感——这不是夏天应该有的感觉。 这种感觉现在正在全国蔓延，远远超出了像马拉库塔这样历史上容易发生丛林大火的地方。 阿什克罗夫特说：“2019-2020 年的黑色夏天是一个真正的转变；它让人们面对现实，夏天不能再无忧无虑了。” 气候委员会主任兼学者莱斯利·休斯表示，气候变化正在重塑澳大利亚人对夏季的看法：人们不再期待夏季，而是越来越感到担忧。 “他们害怕热浪、丛林大火，无法做以前做的事情。气候变化正在抢走澳大利亚人一年中最期待的部分。” 随着更高的气温和更多的极端天气事件成为该国部分地区假期的固定内容，这是否标志着“伟大的澳大利亚夏季”的结束？ 根据国家气候风险评估，澳大利亚现在的平均气温比一个世纪前高 1.5 摄氏度。它正在引发更加极端的热浪和危险的火灾天气。 莫纳什气候科学家安德鲁·沃特金斯 (Andrew Watkins)，前气象局局长...

reflection.en: The Australian summer, a time of tradition and celebration, is increasingly threatened by the harsh realities of climate change. The fires described in Mallacoota are not just isolated incidents but symptoms of a larger distress, a 'groaning' of creation as described in Romans 8:22. As we face these disruptions, may we seek wisdom to adapt our traditions...
reflection.zh: 澳大利亚的夏天，一个充满传统和庆祝的季节，正日益受到气候变化严峻现实的威胁。马拉库塔所描述的火灾不仅仅是孤立的事件，更是更大痛苦的征兆，正如罗马书 8:22 所述，是受造之物的“叹息”。当我们面对这些干扰时，愿我们寻求智慧来调整我们的传统，并照管托付给我们的土地。

verse.textEn: We know that the whole creation has been groaning as in the pains of childbirth right up to the present time.
verse.textZh: 我们知道，一切受造之物一同叹息、劳苦，直到如今。

title.en: ‘Sisyphus would be proud’: Queensland tribunal orders repairs to pool that doesn’t exist
title.zh: “西西弗斯会为此感到骄傲”：昆士兰法庭下令修复一个不存在的泳池

summary.en: A Queensland tribunal has ordered a company to repair a swimming pool that no longer exists, only to immediately stay its own order, deeming the repairs 'impossible' to carry out. The tribunal compared the situation to the Greek myth of Sisyphus, who was condemned to eternally roll a boulder uphill.
summary.zh: 昆士兰一个法庭命令一家公司修复一个已不存在的游泳池，但随后立即搁置了自己的命令，认为修复工作“不可能”完成。法庭将此情境比作希腊神话中西西弗斯永恒地将巨石推上山顶的命运。

body.en:
In an act it compared to the ancient Greek myth of a man forced to roll a rock up a hill forever, a Queensland tribunal has ordered a company to make repair works on a pool that no longer exists.

Peter Roney KC, a member of the Queensland Civil and Administrative Tribunal, handed down a judgment in the case this week.

“I have been called upon to decide many outcomes in some strange and unusual circumstances whilst a member of this tribunal, but this case has its own special place,” Roney wrote.

The case was a challenge brought by the building firm Abel Gaspi Apolonia against what the tribunal said was an “almost incomprehensible” direction by the Queensland Building and Construction Commission relating to work done on a pool in Capalaba in 2021.

Part of the pool’s coping – a finish installed around the edges to stop leaking and prevent swimmers slipping – had had not been installed correctly and had sustained damage after heavy rain, the tribunal heard.

According to the judgment, the commission in 2024 directed the company that because “the installation of the copping (sic) has not been installed in an expected competent tradesman like manner” that “the non-structural defect falls Within 12 months of practical completion”.

But the tribunal said it was difficult to understand what work the commission wanted done and what the defect was.

The tribunal also said there was an even more fundamental problem: the pool had been removed in the meantime.

“After several hours of a hearing being conducted, using the resources of this state to determine what seemed to be an issue designed to protect a homeowner who had contracted for work on her pool, it was discovered, but only when the Commission checked, that the pool had ceased to exist for some years, and that the directive could not be given effect to in any way,” the judgment reads.

A lawyer acting for the QBCC submitted that the tribunal should still make a judgment, on the basis that it would be recorded on the builder’s licence history.

“To expect the resources of this state to be committed to making findings about the appropriateness of decision-making years earlier, in which has little or no practical significance, might be seen by many as a waste of public resources,” it reads.

“To decide the case anyway becomes an almost academic exercise. I will do so anyway. Sisyphus would be proud.”

The company argued that the pool was already old and defective before it was commissioned to work on it, that it made repairs that it had not been paid for and that the damage was caused by “excessive rainfall, soil movement, and the natural aging of the pool structure” rather than poor workmanship.

The tribunal ruled that the company had not repaired the coping as it said, and ordered that it rectify its...
body.zh: 昆士兰法庭下令一家公司对一个不复存在的水池进行修复工作，这一行为类似于古希腊神话中的一个人被迫将一块岩石永远滚上山的故事。 昆士兰民事和行政法庭成员 Peter Roney KC 本周对此案作出了判决。 罗尼写道：“作为该法庭的成员，我被要求在一些奇怪和不寻常的情况下决定许多结果，但这个案件有其特殊的地位。” 该案是建筑公司 Abel Gaspi Apolonia 对昆士兰州建筑和建设委员会关于 2021 年卡帕拉巴泳池工程的指示提出的质疑，仲裁庭称该指示“几乎难以理解”。 法庭获悉，游泳池顶部的一部分——在边缘安装的一个饰面，以防止渗漏并防止游泳者滑倒——安装不正确，在大雨后遭受了损坏。 根据判决，委员会在 2024 年指示该公司，由于“顶部（原文如此）的安装并未按照预期的合格技工方式进行安装”，“非结构性缺陷将在实际完成后的 12 个月内发生”。 但仲裁庭表示，很难理解委员会想要完成哪些工作以及缺陷是什么。 法庭还表示，还有一个更根本的问题：游泳池同时被拆除。 判决书写道：“经过几个小时的听证会，利用本州的资源来确定一个似乎旨在保护在其泳池上承包工程的房主的问题，但只有在委员会检查后才发现，该泳池已不复存在多年，并且该指令无法以任何方式生效。” QBCC 的一名代理律师表示，仲裁庭仍应做出判决，因为该判决将记录在建筑商的许可证历史中。 报告写道：“期望该州的资源致力于早些年就决策的适当性进行调查，而这几乎没有或根本没有实际意义，可能被许多人视为浪费公共资源。” “无论如何，决定这个案子几乎成了一项学术活动。无论如何我都会这样做。西西弗斯会感到自豪。” 该公司辩称，该泳池在委托维修之前就已经陈旧且有缺陷，并且进行了未付款的维修，并且损坏是由“过量降雨、土壤移动和泳池结构自然老化”造成的，而不是由于工艺不良造成的。 仲裁庭裁定该公司没有按照其所说修复顶部，并责令其纠正......

reflection.en: The Queensland Civil and Administrative Tribunal found itself in a peculiar bind, ordering repairs on a non-existent pool and then admitting the task was impossible. This echoes the prophet Habakkuk's lament over a justice system that seemed broken and ineffective, where the law itself was perverted. It reminds us to pray for wisdom and integrity in all our...
reflection.zh: 昆士兰民事和行政法庭发现自己陷入了一个奇怪的困境，命令修复一个不存在的泳池，然后承认这项任务是不可能的。这呼应了先知哈巴谷对一个似乎破碎且无效的司法系统的哀叹，在那里法律本身被扭曲了。它提醒我们要为所有机构的智慧和正直祈祷，使它们能够服务于真正的正义，而不是沦为荒诞的闹剧。

verse.textEn: The law is paralyzed, and justice never prevails. The wicked hem in the righteous, so that justice is perverted.
verse.textZh: 因此律法放松，公理也不显明；恶人围困义人，所以公理显然颠倒。

title.en: El Niño is already wreaking havoc around the world — and it's only getting started
title.zh: 厄尔尼诺已在全球造成破坏——而这仅仅是开始

summary.en: The strengthening El Niño is already disrupting lives around the world, as the United Nations warns the "surging" climate pattern is raising the risk of months of heatwaves, floods, drought and extreme weather. The World Meteorological Organization (WMO) stated there is a "nearly 100 per cent" likelihood that El Niño...
summary.zh: 正在加强的厄尔尼诺现象已在全球范围内扰乱人们的生活，联合国警告称，这一“汹涌”的气候模式增加了未来数月出现热浪、洪水、干旱和极端天气的风险。世界气象组织（WMO）表示，厄尔尼诺现象“几乎有100%的可能性”将持续到明年二月，这是有史以来首次如此明确的厄尔尼诺更新。世界气象组织秘书长塞莱斯特·绍洛指出，自今年六月正式宣布...

body.en:
The strengthening El Niño is already disrupting lives around the world, as the United Nations warns the "surging" climate pattern is raising the risk of months of heatwaves, floods, drought and extreme weather.

On Thursday, the World Meteorological Organization (WMO) said there was a likelihood of "nearly 100 per cent" that El Niño will persist through to February, noting that this was the first time that an El Niño update had been so unequivocal.

The WMO's secretary-general, Celeste Saulo, said the climate driver, which was officially declared underway in June, has already dealt a blow to communities worldwide.

"We are already seeing disruption and devastation from droughts and floods and we expect these impacts to increase as El Niño intensifies," she said.

The phenomenon is expected to peak at very high intensity towards the end of the year — potentially at a record-breaking level — with lasting effects on the climate well into 2027 and the prospect of unprecedented global heat.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

UN secretary-general António Guterres warned that El Niño is "being supersized before our eyes" by climate change.

"The science leaves no room for doubt: the planet is in uncharted waters, and those waters are heating up," Guterres said in response to the WMO update.

El Niño is associated with higher global temperatures and can bring drought and extreme heat to some regions while increasing rainfall and flood risks in others.

In Australia, El Niño typically increases the likelihood of hotter, drier conditions in the east and south-east, though its influence varies, and other climate factors also shape rainfall and temperatures.

Warmer-than-usual weather is expected across most of Australia through the spring.

More than a million students are learning remotely this week as toxic wildfire haze blankets parts of Indonesia, with officials warning that efforts to extinguish the blazes are entering a critical phase.

"Our problems are not over. September is the peak of El Niño," Indonesia's forestry minister Raja Juli Antoni told reporters this week.

El Niño is driving hotter, drier conditions in the region, intensifying a dry season that has seen thousands of hectares burnt.

Indonesian forest fire forensics expert Bambang Hero Saharjo told the BBC this year's El Niño-fuelled blazes could burn an area as large as 11 million hectares.

The haze has spread across parts of Southeast Asia, triggering health warnings and hospitalisations.

The health ministry in neighbouring Malaysia has reported rising cases of asthma and conjunctivitis nationwide as air quality...
body.zh: 不断加强的厄尔尼诺现象已经扰乱了世界各地的生活，联合国警告称，这种“急剧上升”的气候模式正在增加持续数月的热浪、洪水、干旱和极端天气的风险。 周四，世界气象组织（WMO）表示，厄尔尼诺现象有“近100%”的可能性将持续到二月份，并指出这是第一次如此明确地更新厄尔尼诺现象。 世界气象组织秘书长塞莱斯特·索洛 (Celeste Saulo) 表示，6 月份正式宣布启动的气候驱动计划已经对世界各地的社区造成了打击。 她说：“我们已经看到干旱和洪水造成的破坏和破坏，预计随着厄尔尼诺现象的加剧，这些影响将会加剧。” 预计这种现象将在年底达到非常高的强度——可能达到破纪录的水平——对气候的持续影响将持续到 2027 年，全球可能会出现前所未有的高温。 您值得信赖的来源，让您了解周围世界的最新动态。直接将免费的每日新闻更新和分析发送到您的收件箱。 联合国秘书长安东尼奥·古特雷斯警告说，气候变化导致厄尔尼诺现象“在我们眼前变得更加严重”。 古特雷斯在回应世界气象组织的最新消息时表示：“科学不容置疑：地球正处于未知水域，而且这些水域正在升温。” 厄尔尼诺现象与全球气温升高有关，可能给一些地区带来干旱和极端高温，同时增加其他地区的降雨和洪水风险。 在澳大利亚，厄尔尼诺现象通常会增加东部和东南部出现更热、更干燥天气的可能性，尽管其影响各不相同，而且其他气候因素也会影响降雨量和气温。 预计整个春季澳大利亚大部分地区的天气将比平常温暖。 本周，有毒野火烟雾笼罩印度尼西亚部分地区，超过一百万学生正在远程学习，官员警告说，扑灭大火的努力正进入关键阶段。 “我们的问题还没有结束。九月是厄尔尼诺现象的顶峰，”印度尼西亚林业部长拉贾·朱利·安东尼本周告诉记者。 厄尔尼诺现象导致该地区气候变得更加炎热、干燥，加剧了旱季，导致数千公顷土地被烧毁。 印度尼西亚森林火灾法医专家 Bambang Hero Saharjo 告诉 BBC，今年厄尔尼诺现象引发的大火可能会烧毁面积达 1100 万公顷的土地。 雾霾已经蔓延到东南亚部分地区，引发健康警告和住院治疗。 邻国马来西亚卫生部报告称，由于空气质量问题，全国哮喘和结膜炎病例不断增加……

reflection.en: The world's climate system, like all of creation, groans under the weight of forces beyond its immediate control. The "disruption and devastation" wrought by El Niño serves as a stark reminder of our planet's vulnerability and interconnectedness. In these times of extreme weather, we are called to lament the brokenness we witness and to seek wisdom in...
reflection.zh: 世界的气候系统，如同所有被造物一样，在无法掌控的力量重压下发出呻吟。厄尔尼诺现象所带来的“混乱和毁灭”是地球脆弱性和相互关联性的一个严峻警示。在这些极端天气频发的时刻，我们被呼召为所见的破碎而哀恸，并在照管受托于我们的地球时寻求智慧。

verse.textEn: We know that the whole creation has been groaning as in the pains of childbirth right up to the present time.
verse.textZh: 我们知道，一切受造之物一同叹息、劳苦，直到如今。

title.en: HK's first robot-run store draws curious shoppers

summary.en: Hong Kong's first robot-operated convenience stores attracted curious shoppers on Saturday. Locals interacted with a humanoid shopkeeper, chatting with it in multiple languages and watching it dance. The stores, launched by Beijing-based Galbot, are operated by its G1 robot, a 173-cm-tall humanoid designed for retail...
summary.zh: 香港首家机器人运营的便利店于周六吸引了好奇的顾客。当地人与一位人形店员互动，用多种语言与它交谈，并观看它跳舞。这些由北京Galbot公司推出的商店由其G1机器人运营，这是一款身高173厘米、专为零售任务设计的人形机器人，提供24小时零食和饮料。这款名为“小盖”的机器人会说普通话、粤语和英语，标志着Galbot首次在中国...

body.en: Hong Kong's first robot-operated convenience stores drew curious shoppers on Saturday, as locals interacted with a humanoid shopkeeper, chatted with it in multiple languages and watched it dance. Beijing-based embodied-intelligence robotics company Galbot launched three outlets in the city, operated by its G1 robot, a 173-cm-tall humanoid designed for retail tasks. The stores, which run 24 hours a day, offer snacks and drinks. The robot, known as Xiaogai, speaks Mandarin, Cantonese and English. Galbot already operates about 200 retail stores across nearly 50 cities on the mainland. The SAR outlets mark its first expansion outside the mainland. The experience intrigued shoppers, including local resident Dylan Tyack, who found it entertaining. “I've been to the mainland quite a bit and had the robot coffee makers and stuff. That's pretty cool. So I think this is a really unique concept, a good idea for Hong Kong, you know? Quite a fun experience," Tyack said. "He sang for us, yeah, its good fun entertaining kind of thing with my daughter, so yeah, pretty fun. Quite surprising how far technology's come. And what we can be in five years time, it'll be interesting. So yeah, it's a cool, cool, cool experience.” However, another resident, Yvonne Lau, noted the technology still needs refinement. "Actually, in my mind it might be able to sing a lot of songs, but it turned out there are copyright issues, so it can't sing them," she said. "Also, I think it is a bit dumb, but it's really a good start. If there are some sudden or unexpected situations, I feel the robot would probably not know how to handle them.” (Reuters) Edited by Azam Khan
body.zh: 周六，香港第一家机器人经营的便利店吸引了好奇的购物者，当地人与人形店主互动，用多种语言与它聊天，并观看它跳舞。总部位于北京的实体智能机器人公司 Galbot 在该市开设了三个门店，由其 G1 机器人运营，G1 机器人是一个高 173 厘米的人形机器人，专为零售任务而设计。这些商店全天 24 小时营业，提供小吃和饮料。该机器人名为“小盖”，会说普通话、粤语和英语。 Galbot已在大陆近50个城市经营约200家零售店。特区分店标志着其首次向大陆以外地区扩张。这种体验引起了购物者的兴趣，其中包括当地居民迪伦·泰克（Dylan Tyack），他觉得这很有趣。 “我去过大陆很多次，买过机器人咖啡机之类的东西。这太酷了。所以我认为这是一个非常独特的概念，对香港来说是个好主意，你知道吗？相当有趣的体验，”泰克说。 “他为我们唱歌，是的，和我女儿一起唱歌很有趣，非常有趣。技术的进步令人惊讶。五年后我们能做到什么，这会很有趣。所以，是的，这是一次很酷、很酷、很酷的体验。”然而，另一位居民 Yvonne Lau 指出，这项技术仍然需要完善。 “实际上，在我看来它可能可以唱很多歌曲，但结果是存在版权问题，所以它不能唱，”她说。 “而且，我觉得这有点愚蠢，但这确实是一个好的开始。如果出现一些突发或意外的情况，我觉得机器人可能不知道如何处理。” （路透社）阿扎姆·汗编辑

reflection.en: The introduction of humanoid robots like 'Xiaogai' in Hong Kong's retail spaces sparks wonder and curiosity about the future of human-machine interaction. As we encounter increasingly sophisticated artificial intelligence, it is a timely reminder to reflect on what makes us uniquely human. Genesis 1:27 reminds us that humanity is created in the image of...
reflection.zh: 香港零售业引入“小盖”这样的人形机器人，引发了人们对人机交互未来的好奇和惊叹。随着我们遇到日益复杂的人工智能，这是一个及时的提醒，让我们反思是什么使我们成为独特的人类。创世记1:27提醒我们，人类是按照雅伟的形象所造，这是一种深刻的尊严，使我们与众不同。

verse.textEn: So God created mankind in his own image, in the image of God he created them; male and female he created them.
verse.textZh: 神就照着自己的形象造人，乃是照着他的形象造男造女。

title.en: Evening News on TV32 - Sep 5
title.zh: 香港电台晚间新闻 - 9月5日

summary.en: Top stories for Saturday, Sep 5, 2026 - The Chief Executive says the government will seek new growth areas in the city's five-year plan. - Two people have been found alive 10 days after the devastating floods near the China-Nepal border. - Explosions at an army base in Bolivia...
summary.zh: 2026年9月5日星期六主要新闻 - 行政长官表示，政府将在城市五年计划中寻求新的增长领域。 - 在中国尼泊尔边境附近发生毁灭性洪水十天后，两人被发现仍然活着。 - 玻利维亚一军事基地发生爆炸……

reflection.en: As Hong Kong's Chief Executive outlines a five-year plan to find new growth areas, the ancient words of Jeremiah echo. Leaders are called not just to economic planning, but to a fundamental duty of justice and righteousness towards their people. True progress is measured by the well-being and fairness experienced by all citizens.
reflection.zh: 香港行政长官在概述五年计划以寻求新的增长领域时，耶利米先知的古老话语回响。领袖的职责不仅在于经济规划，更在于对人民的基本公义和正直。真正的进步是以所有公民所体验到的福祉和公平来衡量的。

verse.textEn: Do what is just and right. Rescue from the hand of the oppressor the one who has been robbed.
verse.textZh: 你们要施行公平和公义，拯救被抢夺的脱离欺压人的手。

title.en: How can future doctors blend clinical rigour with AI fluency and empathy?
title.zh: 未来医生如何将临床严谨与人工智能熟练度和同理心相结合？

summary.en: Medical experts have stressed that Hong Kong’s next generation of healthcare professionals must combine clinical rigour with emotional resilience, an open-minded approach to artificial intelligence (AI) and the drive to transform the sector. The remarks came during a panel discussion on the first day of the inaugural...
summary.zh: 医学专家强调，香港下一代医疗专业人员必须将临床严谨与情感韧性、对人工智能（AI）的开放态度以及改革该行业的动力相结合。这些言论是在《南华早报》和汇丰卓越理财联合举办的首届全球教育峰会第一天的专题讨论会上发表的。

body.en: Medical experts have stressed that Hong Kong’s next generation of healthcare professionals must combine clinical rigour with emotional resilience, an open-minded approach to artificial intelligence (AI) and the drive to transform the sector. The remarks came during a panel discussion on the first day of the inaugural Global Education Summit, co-organised by the South China Morning Post and HSBC Premier. “We always talk about people going north, going to Shenzhen … for medical services. But I...
body.zh: 医学专家强调，香港下一代医疗保健专业人员必须将临床严谨性与情绪恢复能力、对人工智能（AI）的开放态度以及推动行业转型的动力结合起来。这些言论是在首届全球教育峰会第一天的小组讨论中发表的，该峰会由《南华早报》和汇丰总理共同举办。 “我们总是谈论人们北上、去深圳……寻求医疗服务。但我……

reflection.en: As artificial intelligence rapidly advances, the world grapples with the implications of ever-increasing knowledge. This story from Hong Kong's medical community reflects on how future doctors must integrate AI's capabilities with their humanistic calling. It's a timely reminder that while knowledge expands, wisdom and compassion must guide its application,...
reflection.zh: 随着人工智能的飞速发展，世界正努力应对知识不断增长所带来的影响。这篇来自香港医学界的故事，反思了未来的医生如何必须将人工智能的能力与其人道主义使命相结合。这是一个及时的提醒：虽然知识在扩展，但智慧和同情心必须指导其应用，确保技术服务于人类。

verse.textEn: But you, Daniel, roll up and seal the words of the scroll until the time of the end. Many will go here and there to increase knowledge.
verse.textZh: 但以理啊，你要隐藏这话，封闭这书，直到末时。必有多人来往奔跑，知识就必增长。

title.en: CHP records three more severe paediatric flu cases
title.zh: 卫生署报告三宗严重儿童流感个案

summary.en: The Centre for Health Protection (CHP) reported three severe flu cases in children on Saturday. All were previously healthy. A six-year-old girl is in critical condition in intensive care, while a three-year-old girl and a 15-year-old boy remain in serious condition.
summary.zh: 卫生防护中心（CHP）周六报告了三宗儿童严重流感个案。所有儿童之前都身体健康。一名六岁女孩情况危急，正在接受深切治疗，而一名三岁女孩和一名十五岁男孩仍处于严重状态。

body.en: The Centre for Health Protection (CHP) on Saturday reported three more severe flu cases in children, all of whom were previously healthy with no underlying conditions. One of them, a six-year-old girl, is currently in critical condition and placed under intensive care at Pamela Youde Nethersole Eastern Hospital. She developed a fever, cough and runny nose on Thursday. Two of her classmates also showed mild flu-like symptoms recently, though neither required hospitalisation. Meanwhile, a three-year-old girl and a 15-year-old boy remain in serious condition. All household contacts of the three patients are currently asymptomatic. Edwin Tsui, Controller of the CHP, said overall flu activity has stayed high since the summer influenza season began. He noted that 16 severe paediatric cases have been recorded since the end of June, including one fatality, with two other patients currently in critical condition. Tsui warned that more outbreaks are expected following the start of the new academic year, urging both parents and schools to stay vigilant and maintain preventive measures. Members of the public are also urged to get vaccinated when the annual Seasonal Influenza Vaccination Programmes begin on September 17. Edited by Azam Khan
body.zh: 卫生防护中心（CHP）周六报告了三起严重的儿童流感病例，所有这些儿童之前都很健康，没有任何潜在疾病。其中一名六岁女童现时情况危急，在东区尤德夫人那打素医院接受重症监护。周四，她出现发烧、咳嗽和流鼻涕的症状。她的两名同学最近也出现了轻微的流感样症状，但两人都不需要住院治疗。与此同时，一名 3 岁女孩和一名 15 岁男孩仍伤势严重。目前，三名患者的所有家庭接触者均无症状。卫生防护中心总监徐埃德温表示，自夏季流感季节开始以来，整体流感活动一直居高不下。他指出，自6月底以来，已记录了16例严重儿科病例，其中1人死亡，另外两名患者目前情况危急。徐警告说，新学年开始后预计会出现更多疫情，敦促家长和学校保持警惕并采取预防措施。年度季节性流感疫苗接种计划于 9 月 17 日开始时，我们还敦促公众接种疫苗。编辑：Azam Khan

reflection.en: The news of severe flu cases in children, particularly the six-year-old girl in critical condition, calls us to remember the fragility of life and the importance of prayer. James 5:14 reminds us to call for the elders of the church to pray over those who are sick, anointing them with oil in the name of Yahweh, trusting in divine healing and comfort.
reflection.zh: 儿童严重流感个案的新闻，特别是那名情况危急的六岁女孩，提醒我们生命的脆弱以及祷告的重要性。雅各书5章14节提醒我们，要为病人请教会长来祷告，奉主的名用油膏他们，信靠雅伟的医治与安慰。

verse.textEn: Is anyone among you sick? Let them call the elders of the church to pray over them.
verse.textZh: 你们中间有病了的呢，他就该请教会的长老来；他们可以奉主的名用油抹他，为他祷告。

title.en: Safety or hostility? Dog owners split over Hong Kong’s crackdown on leash rules
title.zh: 安全还是敌意？香港的狗主人对收紧牵绳规定意见不一

summary.en: Hong Kong authorities' intensified enforcement against dog owners who fail to control their pets has drawn mixed reactions, with supporters welcoming improved safety and critics warning it is stoking panic and hostility. The Agriculture, Fisheries and Conservation Department carried out inspections and enforcement...
summary.zh: 香港当局加强了对未能控制宠物的狗主人的执法力度，此举引发了褒贬不一的反应。支持者欢迎提高安全性，批评者则警告此举正在煽动恐慌和敌意。在最近发生了一系列狗咬人事件后，渔农自然护理署于周六在全港范围内开展了检查和执法行动。

body.en: Hong Kong authorities’ intensified enforcement against dog owners who fail to control their pets has drawn mixed reactions, with supporters welcoming improved safety and critics warning it is stoking panic and hostility. The Agriculture, Fisheries and Conservation Department carried out inspections and enforcement operations across the city on Saturday following a spate of dog attacks in recent weeks. Among those walking their pets at the West Kowloon Cultural District despite the heat were...
body.zh: 香港当局对未能控制宠物的狗主人加强执法，引起了不同的反应，支持者对安全措施的改善表示欢迎，批评者则警告称，这会引发恐慌和敌意。在近几周发生多起狗袭击事件后，渔农自然护理署周六在全市范围内进行了检查和执法行动。尽管天气炎热，在西九文化区遛宠物的人中...

reflection.en: The enforcement of leash rules in Hong Kong has created a divide, with some seeing enhanced safety and others feeling hostility. This situation calls to mind the biblical exhortation to be kind and compassionate towards one another. May we seek to overcome division with empathy, remembering that understanding and gentleness can bridge the gaps that anger...
reflection.zh: 香港收紧牵绳规定的执法行动在市民中造成了分歧，一些人认为这提高了安全性，而另一些人则感到敌意。这种情况让人联想到圣经中劝勉我们要彼此恩慈、心存怜悯。愿我们寻求以同理心化解分歧，并牢记理解与温和能够弥合愤怒和恐惧所造成的隔阂。

verse.textEn: Be kind and compassionate to one another, forgiving each other, just as in Christ God forgave you.
verse.textZh: 并要以恩慈相待，存怜悯的心，彼此饶恕，正如神在基督里饶恕了你们一样。

title.en: Hong Kong mega bridge’s popularity takes toll on helicopter, ferry services: lawmaker
title.zh: 香港大桥的受欢迎程度对直升机和渡轮服务造成了影响：议员

summary.en: The number of vehicles using the mega bridge connecting Hong Kong with Zhuhai and Macau reached a record high of 5.21 million last year, a 19% increase from the previous year. A lawmaker stated that this boom has significantly impacted ferry and helicopter services.
summary.zh: 连接香港与珠海、澳门的超级大桥去年车辆使用量创下新高，达到521万辆，比前一年增长了19%。一位议员表示，这一繁荣景象对渡轮和直升机服务造成了严重影响。

body.en: The number of vehicles using a mega bridge linking Hong Kong with Zhuhai and Macau hit a record high last year, the South China Morning Post has learned, with a lawmaker saying the boom has taken a heavy toll on ferry services and a long-running helicopter service. Transport Department figures obtained by the SCMP showed that vehicle flow via the popular Hong Kong-Zhuhai-Macau Bridge reached a record high of 5.21 million last year, up more than 19 per cent from 4.36 million in 2024. The 2025...
body.zh: 据《南华早报》获悉，去年使用连接香港、珠海和澳门的巨型大桥的车辆数量创下历史新高，一名立法者表示，这种繁荣对渡轮服务和长期运行的直升机服务造成了沉重打击。 《南华早报》获得的运输署数据显示，去年通过热门港珠澳大桥的车流量创下历史新高，达 521 万辆，比 2024 年的 436 万辆增加逾 19%。2025 年...

reflection.en: The surge in traffic on the Hong Kong-Zhuhai-Macau Bridge, while a sign of connectivity, has created unintended consequences for other transport services. This situation calls for leadership that governs with integrity, ensuring that progress in one area does not unduly harm others, reflecting the principle of righteous rule that benefits the whole...
reflection.zh: 香港-珠海-澳门大桥车流量的激增，虽然是连通性的体现，却给其他交通服务带来了意想不到的后果。这种情况呼唤着以诚信治理的领导力，确保一个领域的发展不会不当损害其他领域，体现了造福整个社群的公义统治原则。

verse.textEn: Kings detest wrongdoing, for a throne is established through righteousness.
verse.textZh: 作恶为王所憎恶，因国位是靠公义坚立。

title.en: China artists quit S.Korea art show after organisers let ‘Taiwan’ be used in name of exhibition
title.zh: 中国艺术家因“台湾”参展名称退出韩国艺术展

summary.en: Chinese artists have withdrawn from a major South Korean art exhibition, the Gwangju Biennale, after organizers allowed the name "Taiwan" to be used in an exhibition title. This action has drawn criticism from China and highlights the ongoing political sensitivities surrounding cross-strait relations.
summary.zh: 中国艺术家已退出韩国光州双年展，原因是组织者允许在一场展览的名称中使用“台湾”一词。此举引发了中国的批评，并凸显了海峡两岸关系中持续存在的政治敏感性。

body.en: Chinese artists withdrew from a major South Korean art show after organisers allowed “Taiwan” to be used in the name of an exhibition, officials said Thursday, as China issued a rebuke. Gwangju Biennale. Photo: Gwangju Biennale. The Gwangju Biennale, one of Asia’s largest contemporary art events, is due to open Saturday, with its Pavilion Project bringing together artists from around the world at venues across the southwestern city. The dispute began after Taiwanese artists said organisers had initially agreed to call their exhibition the “Taiwan Pavilion”, but changed the name in June to “NTMoFA”, the acronym for Taiwan’s National Taiwan Museum of Fine Arts. The change was made “without the consent of the participating team, and brutally erased Taiwan from the poster,” the artists said in a joint statement last month, accusing organisers of “political censorship”. China insists Taiwan is part of its territory and has threatened to use force to annex the self-ruled island of more than 23 million people. Last week, the Gwangju Biennale foundation reversed course and agreed to restore the name “Taiwan Pavilion”. Chinese artists then halted preparations for their own pavilion, and on Thursday, the Chinese artists announced they would formally withdraw, according to local media footage. A spokesperson for the foundation told AFP: “We have confirmation the Chinese artists are withdrawing from the biennale.” China’s consulate general in Gwangju said Biennale organisers “openly allowed the Taiwan region of China to participate in the exhibition using a name that is completely inconsistent with its status.” “This constitutes a serious violation of the One China principle,” it said, adding: “We once again urge the organisers of the Gwangju Biennale to immediately rectify their wrongdoing.” South Korea’s foreign ministry spoke up to calm the row, saying that the “government’s basic position regarding Taiwan remains unchanged”. Taiwan’s flag. Photo: Walid Berrazeg/HKFP. The ministry said the decision was made in the cultural and artistic sphere, and “is unrelated to the South Korean government’s position regarding Taiwan.” “We hope that this issue will not affect South Korea-China relations or exchanges and cooperation between the two countries,” they added.
body.zh: 官员周四表示，在组织者允许在展览名称中使用“台湾”一词后，中国艺术家退出了韩国的一场大型艺术展，中国对此予以谴责。光州双年展。照片：光州双年展。亚洲最大的当代艺术活动之一光州双年展将于周六开幕，其展馆项目将来自世界各地的艺术家聚集在这座西南部城市的各个场馆。争议始于台湾艺术家表示，主办方最初同意将他们的展览命名为“台湾馆”，但在六月将其名称改为“NTMoFA”，即台湾国立台湾美术馆的缩写。艺术家们在上个月的一份联合声明中表示，这一改变是“未经参赛团队同意的，并且残酷地将台湾从海报上抹掉”，并指责组织者进行“政治审查”。中国坚称台湾是其领土的一部分，并威胁要使用武力吞并这个拥有超过 2300 万人口的自治岛屿。上周，光州双年展基金会改变立场，同意恢复“台湾馆”名称。据当地媒体报道，中国艺术家随后停止了自己展馆的准备工作，周四，中国艺术家宣布正式退出。该基金会的发言人告诉法新社：“我们已确认中国艺术家将退出双年展。”中国驻光州总领事馆表示，双年展组织者“公然允许中国台湾地区使用与其地位完全不符的名称参加展览”。 “这严重违反了一个中国原则，”声明称，并补充说：“我们再次敦促光州双年展的组织者立即纠正错误行为。”韩国外交部发声平息争端，称“政府对台湾的基本立场没有改变”。台湾的国旗。照片：Walid Berrazeg/HKFP。韩国文化部表示，这一决定是在文化艺术领域做出的，“与韩国政府对台湾的立场无关”。他们补充说：“我们希望这个问题不会影响韩中关系或两国之间的交流与合作。”

reflection.en: The Gwangju Biennale dispute, where Chinese artists withdrew over the naming of a Taiwanese exhibition, illustrates how political sensitivities can disrupt cultural exchange. The desire for peace and harmonious relations, as urged in Romans 12:18, is challenged when nationalistic sentiments lead to withdrawal rather than dialogue.
reflection.zh: 光州双年展的争端，中国艺术家因台湾展览的命名问题而退出，说明了政治敏感性如何扰乱文化交流。罗马书12章18节所敦促的和平与和谐关系之愿望，在民族主义情绪导致退出而非对话时受到挑战。

verse.textEn: If it is possible, as far as it depends on you, live at peace with everyone.
verse.textZh: 若是能行，总要尽力与众人和睦。

title.en: HKFP Lens: ‘Love at last sight’ – bidding farewell to Hong Kong’s modernist General Post Office after 50 years
title.zh: HKFP镜头：“最后的凝视之爱”——告别香港50年的现代主义邮政总局

summary.en: When Hong Kong's General Post Office was constructed in Central fifty years ago, conservationists lamented the demolition of the building it replaced. The former General Post Office was an architectural masterpiece of the Edwardian era, featuring grand archways and granite veranda pillars under a distinctive facade of...
summary.zh: 五十年前，当香港邮政总局在香港岛中环建成时，保育人士对它取代的旧建筑被拆毁感到惋惜。旧邮政总局是一座爱德华时代建筑的杰作，拥有宏伟的拱门和花岗岩门廊柱，以及独特的玫瑰色厦门砖外墙，这被认为是抵御南中国海岸风暴的耐用性标杆。邮政总局位于干诺道2号的底层入口。十多年前，香港历史博物馆前总馆长曾称赞它为“香港最美丽的建筑”。

body.en: When the General Post Office was built in Central half a century ago, conservationists mourned the loss of the building it replaced. Exterior of the General Post Office. Photo: Kyle Lam/HKFP. The old General Post Office was a marvel of Edwardian architecture: sweeping archways and granite veranda pillars beneath a distinctive façade of rose-coloured Amoy brick – the gold standard for durability on the storm-lashed South China coast. The GPO’s ground-floor entrance at 2 Connaught Place. Photo: Kyle Lam/HKFP. Just over a decade ago, the former chief curator of the Hong Kong Museum of History crowned it “Hong Kong’s most beautiful building” when it stood at the site of what is now World-Wide House. For others , its loss ranked alongside the demolition of the old Hong Kong Club as one of the greatest architectural crimes the city has committed against itself. Post Office Private Boxes on the second floor of the GPO. Photo: Kyle Lam/HKFP. But fast-forward to 2026 and accolades are now pouring in for the much-maligned replacement structure. Ahead of its own demolition, the current modernist General Post Office, erected in 1976, is belatedly finding recognition as an icon of modern Hong Kong heritage. Service counters in the General Post Office. Photo: Kyle Lam/HKFP. Crouching just five storeys above the Central harbourfront – its planned stature stunted so as to preserve the sea view from Jardine House – the post office’s sharp lines and white concrete walls buck against its ornate predecessor. Customers queue in the main hall of the GPO. Photo: Kyle Lam/HKFP. Yet, in retrospect, it’s clear to see how these design choices reflected the society it was born into: one that, by the 1970s, prized simple, utilitarian structures that served a rapidly growing population first and foremost. In the headlong rush to modernise and develop, form followed function – and decoration was optional. Towers of parcels wait at a GPO counter. Photo: Kyle Lam/HKFP. It’s not the first time a modern landmark has, with time, won the hearts of Hongkongers. A row of desks in the GPO. Photo: Kyle Lam/HKFP. The looming demise of the GPO’s erstwhile neighbour, Edinburgh Place Ferry Pier, sparked spirited protests and a sit-in by conservationists in 2006. Although they failed to protect the 1950s landmark, many saw the movement as a watershed moment that led to the localist movement and pro-democracy mobilisation of the 2010s. A stairwell inside the GPO. Photo: Kyle Lam/HKFP. In North Point, efforts to save the mid-century State Theatre have been ongoing for a decade, with some hard-won concessions from the government and developers. A second-floor window in the GPO overlooks the Court of Final Appeal Building....
body.zh: 半个世纪前，当邮政总局在中环建成时，自然资源保护主义者对它所取代的建筑物的损失表示哀悼。邮政总局的外观。照片：Kyle Lam/HKFP。旧邮政总局是爱德华时代建筑的奇迹：宽阔的拱门和花岗岩阳台柱子位于独特的玫瑰色厦门砖外墙之下，这是暴风雨肆虐的华南海岸耐用性的黄金标准。 GPO 底层入口位于康诺特广场 2 号。照片：Kyle Lam/HKFP。就在十多年前，当它矗立在现在的环球大厦旧址时，香港历史博物馆前总馆长将其誉为“香港最美丽的建筑”。对于其他人来说，它的损失与拆除旧香港会一样，是这座城市对自己犯下的最大的建筑罪行之一。邮局私人信箱位于 GPO 二楼。照片：Kyle Lam/HKFP。但快进到 2026 年，备受诟病的替代结构获得的赞誉纷至沓来。建于 1976 年的现代主义风格的邮政总局在被拆除之前，后来才被认为是现代香港遗产的象征。邮政总局的服务柜台。照片：Kyle Lam/HKFP。邮局坐落在中环海滨上方仅五层楼高处，其规划的高度被限制，以保留怡和大厦的海景。邮局的锐利线条和白色混凝土墙与其华丽的前身形成鲜明对比。顾客在 GPO 大厅排队。照片：Kyle Lam/HKFP。然而，回想起来，我们可以清楚地看到这些设计选择如何反映了它诞生的社会：到了 20 世纪 70 年代，这个社会推崇简单、实用的结构，首先是为快速增长的人口服务。在现代化和发展的急速推进中，形式追随功能——装饰是可选的。 GPO 柜台前堆满了包裹。照片：Kyle Lam/HKFP。随着时间的推移，现代地标赢得了香港人的心，这并不是第一次。 GPO 中的一排办公桌。照片：Kyle Lam/HKFP。 2006 年，GPO 的昔日邻居爱丁堡广场渡轮码头即将消亡，引发了自然资源保护主义者的激烈抗议和静坐。尽管他们未能保护 1950 年代的地标，但许多人认为这场运动是导致 2010 年代地方主义运动和民主动员的分水岭。 GPO 内的楼梯间。照片：Kyle Lam/HKFP。在北角，拯救中世纪国家剧院的努力已经持续了十年，政府和开发商做出了一些来之不易的让步。总督察署二楼的一扇窗户俯瞰着终审法院大楼……

reflection.en: For fifty years, the General Post Office building stood in Central, a landmark that has now reached the end of its public service life. The story notes the lament of conservationists for the beautiful Edwardian building it replaced, highlighting the passage of time and the inevitable changes that come with it. Ecclesiastes reminds us that 'there is a time...
reflection.zh: 五十年来，邮政总局大楼矗立在中环，如今它已走到了公众服务生涯的尽头。故事提到保育人士对它取代的爱德华时代美丽建筑的惋惜，突显了时间的流逝以及随之而来的不可避免的变化。《传道书》提醒我们，“凡事都有定期，天下万务都有定时”，这是建筑物的兴衰和城市发展的变迁所体现的真理。

verse.textEn: There is a time for everything, and a season for every activity under the heavens.
verse.textZh: 凡事都有定期，天下万务都有定时。

title.en: Hong Kong pro-democracy activist Joshua Wong pleads guilty in second national security case
title.zh: 香港民主派活动人士黄之锋承认在第二起国安案中认罪

summary.en: Joshua Wong, a prominent pro-democracy activist in Hong Kong, pleaded guilty on Wednesday to charges under the national security law, specifically conspiring to seek foreign sanctions against China. The charge carries a maximum penalty of life imprisonment.
summary.zh: 香港一位著名的民主派活动人士黄之锋周三承认触犯国安法，罪名是共谋寻求外国制裁中国，该罪名最高可判处无期徒刑。

body.en: Wong, 29, is accused of urging foreign powers to impose sanctions, blockades and other hostile measures against China Joshua Wong , one of Hong Kong’s most prominent pro-democracy activists, pleaded guilty on Wednesday to conspiring to seek foreign sanctions against Hong Kong and China, a national security charge that carries a maximum life sentence. Prosecutors have accused Wong, 29, of working with the exiled Hong Kong activist Nathan Law to urge foreign powers to impose sanctions, blockades or other hostile measures against China. Continue reading...
body.zh: 29 岁的黄之锋被指控敦促外国势力对中国实施制裁、封锁和其他敌对措施。香港最著名的民主活动人士之一黄之锋周三承认密谋寻求外国对香港和中国实施制裁，这一国家安全指控最高可判处无期徒刑。检察官指控 29 岁的黄与流亡香港活动人士罗冠聪合作，敦促外国势力对中国实施制裁、封锁或其他敌对措施。继续阅读...

reflection.en: Joshua Wong, a young activist known for his role in Hong Kong's democracy movement, has pleaded guilty to charges under the national security law. This situation brings to the fore the difficult tension between civic obedience and deeply held convictions. The apostles' unwavering stance, 'We must obey God rather than human beings,' offers a timeless...
reflection.zh: 香港一位以其在民主运动中角色而闻名的年轻活动人士黄之锋，已承认触犯国安法。这一局面凸显了公民服从与内心深处信念之间的艰难张力。使徒们坚定的立场——“顺从神，过于顺从人”——为这种良心冲突提供了永恒的视角。

verse.textEn: We must obey God rather than human beings!
verse.textZh: 顺从神，不顺从人，是应当的。

title.en: Shein shares slide on fast-fashion retailer’s stock market debut
title.zh: Shein股票上市首日下跌，快时尚零售商估值缩水

summary.en: Shares of the fast-fashion brand Shein fell as much as 10% on their debut on the Hong Kong stock exchange. The company, founded in China and now headquartered in Singapore, was valued at just over $26 billion, a significant drop from its previous valuation of nearly $100 billion.
summary.zh: 快时尚品牌Shein在香港证券交易所上市首日股价下跌高达10%。这家中国创立、现总部设在新加坡的公司，估值略高于260亿美元，远低于其此前近1000亿美元的估值。

body.en: Hong Kong flotation at $26bn by firm once valued at $100bn follows failure to list in US and UK Shares in the fast-fashion brand Shein slumped by as much as 10% as the China-founded company made its long-anticipated trading debut on the Hong Kong stock exchange. The Singapore-headquartered company, once valued at almost $100bn (£74bn), went public on Tuesday pricing shares at HK$48.56, valuing the business at just over $26bn. Continue reading...
body.zh: 曾估值 1000 亿美元的公司在香港发行 260 亿美元，此前该公司未能在美国和英国上市。快时尚品牌 Shein 在香港证券交易所首次上市后，其股价下跌了 10%。这家总部位于新加坡的公司一度估值近 1000 亿美元（740 亿英镑），周二上市，股价为 48.56 港元，业务估值略高于 260 亿美元。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The dramatic drop in Shein's valuation on its Hong Kong stock market debut, from nearly $100 billion to just over $26 billion, serves as a potent reminder of the volatile nature of commerce. Proverbs 16:3 encourages us to commit our endeavors to Yahweh, trusting that He will establish our plans, a wisdom that transcends market highs and lows.
reflection.zh: Shein在香港股市上市首日估值从近1000亿美元暴跌至略高于260亿美元，这有力地提醒我们商业的波动性。箴言16:3鼓励我们将所做的事交托给雅伟，信靠祂必成就我们的计划，这智慧超越了市场的起伏。

verse.textEn: Commit to Yahweh whatever you do, and he will establish your plans.
verse.textZh: 你所做的，要交托雅伟，你所谋的，就必成立。

title.en: Some disagreement makes groups more trustworthy, mathematical framework finds
title.zh: 一些分歧使群体更值得信赖，数学框架发现

summary.en: When humans make decisions, they don't rely solely on their own thoughts and available evidence. Past studies show people are influenced by others' choices and opinions, sometimes conforming to the majority even if it contradicts their own judgment or information, a tendency known as conformity bias.
summary.zh: 人类在做决定时，并非仅依赖自己的考量和现有证据。过往研究表明，人们也常受他人选择和意见的影响，有时甚至会屈从于多数人的判断，即使这与他们自己的想法或所获信息相悖，这种倾向被称为从众偏见。

body.en:
This article has been reviewed according to Science X's editorial process and policies . Editors have highlighted the following attributes while ensuring the content's credibility:

When humans are making decisions, they are known not to rely solely on their own considerations and the evidence available to them. Past behavioral science and psychology studies have shown that people are often also influenced by the choices and opinions of others.

For example, many people tend to conform to the judgments and opinions of the majority, even if they conflict with their own or with the information they are presented with. In behavioral science, this tendency is referred to as conformity bias.

Researchers at the University of Toulouse-CNRS and the University of Leeds recently used a mathematical approach to investigate how groups of experts make decisions and whether dissent influences the reliability of their choices.

Their findings, published in the Journal of the Royal Society Interface , suggest that high levels of agreement or unanimity during group decision-making are not always signs of expertise and trustworthiness.

"While reading a previous paper, we realized that a paradoxical—yet intuitive—result could emerge from Bayesian decision-making," Aurèle Boussard, first author of the paper, told Phys.org.

"In this mathematical framework, individuals balance private and social information in an optimal way. From that, it reasonably follows that the more individuals agree, the more likely the group is to be right. However, we found situations leading to the opposite conclusion, in which the more confident a group seems, the less trustworthy it is."

Earlier observations by behavioral scientists suggest that a group's overconfidence in a decision can sometimes indicate conformity bias or other cognitive biases. In other words, individuals in the group might have simply agreed with the decision that the majority was leaning toward or may have made an unconsidered choice.

"We were surprised to predict a lower majority accuracy at high agreement (compared with slightly lower agreement, i.e., some dissent), so we decided to investigate," explained Boussard.

"We started with the basic tools of probability theory to model how an individual would make the best decision given some information (both private and social). This is an idealized version of reality in which individuals are not assumed to be cognitively biased. That idealization is, however, useful because it gives a clear baseline to which we can add specific biases, such as conformity—the tendency to align one's judgment with a group."

There are numerous different ways of mathematically modeling conformity. In their paper, Boussard and colleagues used four distinct formulations: two information...
body.zh: 本文已根据 Science X 的编辑流程和政策进行审阅。编辑在确保内容可信度的同时强调了以下属性： 众所周知，当人类做出决定时，他们不会仅仅依赖自己的考虑和现有的证据。过去的行为科学和心理学研究表明，人们常常也会受到他人的选择和意见的影响。 例如，许多人倾向于遵循大多数人的判断和意见，即使这些判断和意见与自己的判断和意见或与他们收到的信息相冲突。在行为科学中，这种倾向被称为从众偏见。 图卢兹大学法国国家科学研究中心和利兹大学的研究人员最近使用数学方法来研究专家组如何做出决策以及异议是否会影响他们选择的可靠性。 他们发表在《皇家学会界面杂志》上的研究结果表明，群体决策过程中高度一致或一致并不总是专业知识和可信度的标志。 该论文的第一作者 Aurèle Boussard 告诉 Phys.org：“在阅读之前的论文时，我们意识到贝叶斯决策可能会出现矛盾但直观的结果。” “在这个数学框架中，个人以最佳方式平衡私人信息和社会信息。由此可见，个人同意越多，群体就越有可能是正确的。然而，我们发现了导致相反结论的情况，即一个群体看起来越自信，它就越不值得信任。” 行为科学家的早期观察表明，一个群体对决策的过度自信有时可能表明存在从众偏见或其他认知偏见。换句话说，群体中的个人可能只是简单地同意了大多数人倾向于的决定，或者可能做出了未经考虑的选择。 Boussard 解释说：“我们惊讶地发现，在高度一致的情况下，多数准确率较低（与稍低的一致意见相比，即存在一些异议），因此我们决定进行调查。” “我们从概率论的基本工具开始，模拟个人如何在给定一些信息（私人和社会）的情况下做出最佳决策。这是现实的理想化版本，其中个人不被认为存在认知偏见。然而，这种理想化是有用的，因为它提供了一个明确的基线，我们可以在该基线上添加特定的偏见，例如从众性——将一个人的判断与群体保持一致的倾向。” 对一致性进行数学建模有多种不同的方法。在他们的论文中，布萨德和同事使用了四种不同的表述：两种信息……

reflection.en: This research suggests that a diversity of viewpoints, even disagreement, can strengthen a group's reliability. In our own lives, seeking out different perspectives and engaging with them thoughtfully, rather than simply conforming, can lead to wiser decisions and a deeper understanding of truth.
reflection.zh: 这项研究表明，观点的多样性，甚至是分歧，可以增强群体的可靠性。在我们自己的生活中，寻求不同的视角并进行有意义的探讨，而不是盲目从众，可以带来更明智的决策和对真理更深刻的理解。

verse.textEn: The heart of the discerning acquires knowledge, for the ears of the wise seek it out.
verse.textZh: 聪明人的心得知识；智慧人的耳求知识。

title.en: Lakes aren't just storing water—they're changing the carbon cycle
title.zh: 湖泊不仅在储存水——它们还在改变碳循环

summary.en: Lakes, often seen as passive water bodies, play a significant role in the landscape's carbon cycle. New research indicates that areas with more lakes release more carbon into the atmosphere rather than transporting it downstream, based on studies of stream-and-lake networks in northern Sweden.
summary.zh: 湖泊不仅是河流或溪流中风景如画的停靠点，它们还能对碳在景观中的迁移产生重大影响。一项新的研究表明，溪流网络中湖泊越多，释放到大气中的碳就越多，而不是被向下游输送。这项研究基于对瑞典北部湖泊溪流网络的分析。

body.en:
This article has been reviewed according to Science X's editorial process and policies . Editors have highlighted the following attributes while ensuring the content's credibility:

Lakes may look like picturesque stopping points along a river or stream, but they can have a big influence on what happens to carbon as it moves through a landscape. New research suggests that the more lake-rich a network of streams is, the more carbon is released into the atmosphere rather than carried downstream.

The finding, published in Geophysical Research Letters , comes from researchers who studied 32 connected stream-and-lake networks in northern Sweden, measuring how much carbon was released into the atmosphere and how much continued downstream. They found that networks with 10 times more lake surface area had almost twice the carbon emissions.

The results highlight a part of the carbon cycle that may have been overlooked by scientists. Rather than treating lakes and streams as separate pieces of the landscape, Fredrik Alriksson, of Sweden's Umeå University, and colleagues argue that they need to be considered together as connected networks.

Streams and rivers constantly pick up carbon from the land around them and carry it downstream toward larger rivers and eventually the ocean. However, some is transformed into gases, including carbon dioxide, and escapes from the water into the atmosphere.

How much carbon each route takes depends partly on how long the water stays within the aquatic network. A fast-flowing stream can carry carbon downstream relatively quickly, while a lake can slow the journey considerably, giving chemical and biological processes more time to act on the carbon.

The researchers call the length of time water remains within a stream-and-lake network its "network residence time." In the Swedish networks they studied, this varied enormously, from just 42 minutes to as long as 29 years. Lakes accounted for almost all of this residence time.

To investigate what this means for the carbon cycle, the team repeatedly sampled the networks during four different periods: spring snowmelt, early summer, late-summer low flow and autumn high flow. They measured carbon dioxide emissions across more than 360 sections of streams and from 42 lakes, while also estimating how much dissolved carbon was being transported downstream.

The pattern was striking. Networks with 10 times more aquatic surface area had approximately 35 times longer residence times and 1.8 times higher carbon emissions relative to downstream carbon export.

One likely explanation is that keeping carbon in the water longer gives microbes more opportunity to break down dissolved organic carbon. This process can ultimately produce carbon dioxide, which can then escape from the water into...
body.zh: 本文已根据 Science X 的编辑流程和政策进行审阅。编辑在确保内容可信度的同时强调了以下属性： 湖泊可能看起来像河流或溪流沿岸风景如画的停靠点，但它们可以对碳在景观中移动时发生的变化产生重大影响。新的研究表明，河流网络中的湖泊越丰富，释放到大气中而不是带到下游的碳就越多。 这项发现发表在《地球物理研究快报》上，来自研究人员，他们研究了瑞典北部 32 个相互连接的河流和湖泊网络，测量了有多少碳被释放到大气中，以及有多少碳继续下游。他们发现，湖泊表面积增加 10 倍的网络的碳排放量几乎是原来的两倍。 研究结果凸显了碳循环中可能被科学家忽视的一部分。瑞典于默奥大学的 Fredrik Alriksson 及其同事认为，不应将湖泊和溪流视为景观的独立部分，而是应将它们视为相互连接的网络。 溪流和河流不断地从周围的土地中吸收碳，并将其带到下游，流向更大的河流，最终进入海洋。然而，有些会转化为气体，包括二氧化碳，并从水中逸出到大气中。 每条路线消耗的碳量部分取决于水在水生网络中停留的时间。快速流动的溪流可以相对较快地将碳携带到下游，而湖泊可以大大减慢旅程，使化学和生物过程有更多时间对碳起作用。 研究人员将水在溪流和湖泊网络中停留的时间长度称为“网络停留时间”。在他们研究的瑞典网络中，时间差异很大，从短短 42 分钟到长达 29 年。湖泊几乎占据了所有的停留时间。 为了研究这对碳循环意味着什么，研究小组在四个不同时期对网络进行了反复采样：春季融雪、初夏、夏末低流量和秋季高流量。他们测量了 360 多条溪流和​​ 42 个湖泊的二氧化碳排放量，同时还估算了有多少溶解的碳被输送到下游。 这种模式是引人注目的。相对于下游碳出口，水生表面积增加 10 倍的网络的停留时间大约延长 35 倍，碳排放量增加 1.8 倍。 一种可能的解释是，将碳在水中保留更长时间可以让微生物有更多机会分解溶解的有机碳。这个过程最终会产生二氧化碳，然后二氧化碳可以从水中逸出到......

reflection.en: The intricate ways natural systems like lakes influence global processes, such as the carbon cycle, reveal the profound wisdom embedded in creation. Observing these complex interactions invites us to acknowledge the Creator's design and to approach environmental stewardship with humility and awe. As Job 12:7-9 reminds us, 'Ask the animals, and they will...
reflection.zh: 像湖泊这样的自然系统影响全球过程（如碳循环）的复杂方式，揭示了创造中蕴含的深刻智慧。观察这些复杂的相互作用，邀请我们认识到创造者的设计，并以谦卑和敬畏之心对待环境管理。正如约伯记12:7-9所提醒我们的：“你可以问走兽，它们会教导你；天空的飞鸟，它们会告诉你；或与大地说话，它会教导你；海中的鱼，它们会告诉你。”

verse.textEn: But ask the animals, and they will teach you, or the birds in the sky, and they will tell you; or speak to the earth, and it will teach you, or let the fish in the sea inform you.
verse.textZh: 你且问走兽，走兽必指教你；又问空中的飞鸟，飞鸟必告诉你。或与地说话，地必指教你；海中的鱼也必向你说明。

title.en: Flourishing green communities are changing lives
title.zh: 蓬勃发展的绿色社区正在改变生活

summary.en: Four projects have been nominated in the environmental category in Devon's Make a Difference Awards for their work in making communities more eco-friendly, wilder, and healthier through activities like planting trees, growing vegetables, and leading nature exploration.
summary.zh: 在德文郡的“做出改变奖”环保类别中，有四个项目因其在使社区更环保、更野性、更健康方面所做的工作而获得提名，这些项目通过植树、种植蔬菜和组织自然探索等活动来达成目标。

body.en:
Four projects have been nominated in the environmental category in BBC Radio Devon's Make a Difference Awards.

The Growing Well Garden in Bow, the Sampford Peverell Tree Wardens in mid-Devon, Shallowford Farm on Dartmoor, and Sustainable Hatherleigh are being recognised for making their communities more eco-friendly, wilder and healthier.

They are doing this in a range of ways from planting trees and growing vegetables, to leading bug hunts and rediscovering nature.

The winners of the Make a Difference awards are due to be announced on 24 September at Buckfast Abbey.

Growing Well Garden is part of a green social prescribing project, where gardening is used as a therapeutic tool and helps a doctor connect with her patients in a different way.

Dr Susan Taheri is an NHS GP at Bow Medical Practice and the founder of Growing Well Garden project - she said the scheme reignited her passion for being a GP.

She said meeting patients in a garden can have benefits compared to seeing them a consulting room and describes the garden as her "happy place".

"There's a lot more getting your hands dirty and not worrying too much about germs," she said.

Retired horticulturalist Charles Staniland's love for the outdoors started in early childhood and he now volunteers there, teaching young people to get their hands dirty.

He said he wanted to show a more physical approach to food, that it doesn't just show up on a plate, and that it's something they can contribute to.

Staniland hopes the project can "encourage a new generation to understand and value the world around them".

"It takes people out of a concrete environment - it's a very good first step into a greener environment," he said.

Sampford Peverell Tree Wardens are an independent, environmentally-focused, volunteer based group which takes care of the parish's greenery.

For Pete Drew and the other wardens, looking after the environment is a community effort, often powered by cake.

The group plants, protects and maintains trees and hedges on publicly owned land, working with councils and landowners.

He said it was about "taking pride in where you live and making local spaces better for everyone".

Sustainable Hatherleigh runs a range of projects to support the community, from leading bug hunts and encouraging wildflowers and biodiversity in the local graveyard to community composting and running a repair café.

Their site in the middle of the town has now been recognised as a county wildlife site.

Jo Pullin and Sustainable Hatherleigh hope to create a resilient future for the area.

Jo Pullin from Sustainable Hatherleigh, Dr Susan Taheri from Growing Well Garden, Charles Staniland from Shallowford Farm and Pete Drew from Sampford Tree Wardens are finalists in the awards.

body.zh: 四个项目已获得 BBC 德文郡电台“Make a Difference Awards”环境类别提名。 Bow 的 Growing Well Garden、德文郡中部的 Sampford Peverell Tree Wardens、Dartmoor 的 Shallowford Farm 和 Sustainable Hatherleigh 因使社区变得更加环保、更加狂野和健康而受到认可。 他们通过多种方式做到这一点，从植树和种植蔬菜，到领导昆虫狩猎和重新发现自然。 Make a Difference 奖的获奖者将于 9 月 24 日在巴克法斯特修道院公布。 Growing Well Garden 是绿色社会处方项目的一部分，其中园艺被用作治疗工具，帮助医生以不同的方式与患者建立联系。 Susan Taheri 博士是 Bow Medical Practice 的 NHS 全科医生，也是 Growing Well Garden 项目的创始人 - 她说该计划重新点燃了她成为全科医生的热情。 她说，与在咨询室见到病人相比，在花园里会见病人更有好处，并将花园描述为她的“快乐的地方”。 “还有很多事情会弄脏你的双手，而且不用太担心细菌，”她说。 退休园艺家查尔斯·斯坦尼兰 (Charles Staniland) 从童年时期就开始热爱户外活动，现在他在那里做志愿者，教导年轻人要亲自动手。 他说他想展示一种更实际的食物处理方式，食物不仅仅出现在盘子上，而且这是他们可以做出的贡献。 斯坦尼兰希望该项目能够“鼓励新一代了解和重视他们周围的世界”。 “它让人们脱离了具体的环境——这是迈向绿色环境的非常好的第一步，”他说。 Sampford Peverell 树木管理员是一个独立、注重环保、以志愿者为基础的团体，负责照顾教区的绿化。 对于皮特·德鲁和其他狱长来说，保护环境是一项社区努力，通常由蛋糕提供动力。 该组织与议会和土地所有者合作，在公有土地上种植、保护和维护树木和树篱。 他说这是为了“为自己居住的地方感到自豪，并让当地空间对每个人来说都变得更好”。 可持续哈瑟利开展了一系列项目来支持社区，从领导昆虫狩猎、鼓励当地墓地种植野花和生物多样性，到社区堆肥和经营修理咖啡馆。 他们位于镇中心的地点现已被认定为县野生动物保护区。 乔·普林 (Jo Pullin) 和可持续哈瑟利 (Sustainable Hatherleigh) 希望为该地区创造一个充满活力的未来。 来自 Sustainable Hatherleigh 的 Jo Pullin、来自 Growing Well Garden 的 Susan Taheri 博士、来自 Shallowford Farm 的 Charles Staniland 和来自 Sampford Tree Wardens 的 Pete Drew 入围该奖项。 在 X 上关注 BBC Devon，...

reflection.en: The nomination of these four projects in Devon celebrates the tangible impact of community-led environmental initiatives. It echoes the Genesis account where Yahweh surveyed all that was made and declared it 'very good.' These efforts remind us that tending to the earth, growing food, and fostering wild spaces are acts that honor this original goodness.
reflection.zh: 德文郡这四个项目的提名，是对社区主导的环境倡议所产生的切实影响的庆祝。这呼应了《创世记》中雅伟审视他所造的一切，并宣告其“甚好”的记载。这些努力提醒我们，照料大地、种植食物和培育野外空间，都是荣耀这最初美善之举。

verse.textEn: God saw all that he had made, and it was very good.
verse.textZh: 神看着一切所造的都甚好。

title.en: Trump signs order to remove endangered species protection for grey wolves
title.zh: 特朗普签署命令，取消灰狼濒危物种保护

summary.en: The US president says the move will help ranchers, but conservationists say it could derail efforts to recover populations. The executive order removes endangered species protection for the grey wolf and the Mexican wolf, potentially allowing ranchers to kill them to protect livestock, despite conservation groups'...
summary.zh: 美国总统称此举将有助于牧场主，但环保人士表示这可能会破坏种群恢复的努力。该行政命令取消了灰狼和墨西哥狼的濒危物种保护，可能允许牧场主为保护牲畜而杀死它们，尽管环保团体担心这会影响长期的种群恢复工作。

body.en:
Donald Trump has signed an executive order to remove endangered species protection for the grey wolf and a subspecies, the Mexican wolf.

The US president's decision could pave the way for pastoral farmers to kill the canines to protect their livestock. His order said ranchers played a "vital role" in the food supply chain and American cultural heritage.

But conservation groups have criticised the move, saying it could derail long-term efforts to recover the endangered wolf populations.

There were 319 Mexican wolves in the wild in the US in 2025, up from just four when they were reintroduced in 1998, US Fish and Wildlife Service (FWS) figures show.

Meanwhile, there are roughly 18,000 grey wolves across the US, though they are still considered endangered as most of their habitat has been destroyed by humans.

An attempt to de-list them at a federal level in 2022 became tied up in litigation, and some campaigners have indicated they intend to do the same of the US Department of Interior acts on Trump's order.

The executive order does not give ranchers immediate license to shoot wolves preying on livestock, but instead gives Interior Secretary Doug Burgum 90 days to determine whether the grey and Mexican wolf populations had recovered enough to warrant being taken off the endangered species list.

Noting that US livestock herds were at a 75-year low while demand for beef had risen by 10% in the past decade, the order added: "More can and should be done to support this critical industry."

However, environmental groups pointed to studies that suggested wolf attacks on livestock were rare and had little impact on ranchers' income.

"This is a huge distraction to placate a handful of ranchers and make them believe that wolves are a greater threat than President Trump's own policies," said Greta Anderson, deputy director of Western Watersheds Project, which works to conserve wildlife in western US states.

The Wolf Conservation Center noted that ranchers were entitled to up to 100% compensation for any livestock losses caused by wolves under the current system, with individual states providing funding for programmes to deter attacks.

"The Mexican grey wolf is not recovered simply because the population has grown," said Claire Musser, executive director of the Grand Canyon Wolf Recovery Project. "Weakening federal protections now would put decades of recovery work at risk."

The executive order comes as the Trump administration is seeking to lower record-high beef prices for consumers, driven by drought and an outbreak of parasites in US beef stocks.

Ranchers have been frustrated by Trump's decision to loosen restrictions on beef imports to address price rises, putting pressure on their already tight margins.

body.zh: 唐纳德·特朗普签署了一项行政命令，取消对灰狼及其亚种墨西哥狼的濒危物种保护。 美国总统的决定可能为牧民杀死犬科动物以保护牲畜铺平道路。他的命令称，牧场主在食品供应链和美国文化遗产中发挥着“至关重要的作用”。 但保护组织批评了这一举措，称这可能会破坏恢复濒危狼种群的长期努力。 美国鱼类和野生动物管理局 (FWS) 的数据显示，到 2025 年，美国野外有 319 只墨西哥狼，而 1998 年重新引入墨西哥时仅有 4 只。 与此同时，美国各地约有 18,000 只灰狼，但由于它们的大部分栖息地已被人类破坏，它们仍被视为濒临灭绝。 2022 年在联邦层面将它们除名的尝试陷入了诉讼之中，一些活动人士表示，他们打算按照特朗普的命令对美国内政部采取同样的行动。 该行政命令并未给予牧场主立即射杀捕食牲畜的狼的许可，而是给予内政部长道格·布尔古姆 90 天的时间来确定灰狼和墨西哥狼的数量是否已恢复到足以将其从濒危物种名单中删除的程度。 该命令指出，美国牲畜存栏量处于 75 年来的最低水平，而牛肉需求在过去十年中增长了 10%，并补充道：“可以而且应该采取更多措施来支持这一关键行业。” 然而，环保组织指出，研究表明狼袭击牲畜的情况很少见，对牧场主的收入影响不大。 致力于保护美国西部各州野生动物的西部流域项目副主任格蕾塔·安德森表示：“这对安抚少数牧场主来说是一个巨大的干扰，让他们相信狼的威胁比特朗普总统自己的政策更大。” 狼保护中心指出，在现行制度下，牧场主有权对狼造成的任何牲畜损失获得高达 100% 的赔偿，各州还为阻止狼袭击的计划提供资金。 大峡谷狼恢复项目执行董事克莱尔·穆塞尔表示：“墨西哥灰狼的恢复并不仅仅是因为数量增加。” “现在削弱联邦保护将使数十年的恢复工作面临风险。” 这项行政命令发布之际，由于干旱和美国牛肉库存中寄生虫的爆发，特朗普政府正在寻求降低创纪录的高牛肉价格，以供消费者使用。 特朗普决定放宽牛肉进口限制以应对价格上涨，这让牧场主感到沮丧，这给他们本已紧张的利润带来了压力。 美国政府发起了一项运动...

reflection.en: The decision to remove protections for grey wolves pits human economic interests against the survival of a species. This echoes the call to "open your mouth for the speechless, in the cause of all who are appointed to die." The wolves, unable to advocate for themselves, are caught in a conflict where their very existence is debated for the sake of...
reflection.zh: 取消灰狼保护的决定将人类的经济利益与物种的生存对立起来。这呼应了“你要为哑吧开口，声张一切被定罪的，为孤苦者伸冤”。狼群无法为自己辩护，它们的存在本身就成为牲畜利益争论的焦点。愿我们也能为自己社区中那些不能发声的群体开口，为他们的福祉而倡导。

verse.textEn: Speak up for those who cannot speak for themselves, for the rights of all who are destitute. Speak up and judge fairly; defend the rights of the poor and needy.
verse.textZh: 你当为不能自辩的开口，为孤独的伸冤。你当开口按公义判断，为困苦和穷乏的辨屈。

title.en: Life uses 4 DNA letters. Scientists just made 8 work
title.zh: 生命使用4个DNA字母。科学家刚刚让8个奏效

summary.en: Researchers at UC San Diego have demonstrated that a key cellular enzyme can accurately read an eight-letter genetic alphabet, doubling the four letters used by all known life on Earth. Detailed imaging revealed that RNA polymerase handles synthetic DNA letters in surprisingly similar ways to natural ones. The finding...
summary.zh: 加州大学圣地亚哥分校的研究人员已经证明，一种关键的细胞酶可以准确地读取一个八个字母的遗传字母表，是地球上所有已知生命所使用的四倍。详细的成像显示，RNA聚合酶处理合成DNA字母的方式与处理天然DNA字母惊人地相似。这一发现使科学家们更接近于构建能够执行全新生物学功能的扩展遗传系统。

body.en: Researchers at UC San Diego have demonstrated that a key cellular enzyme can accurately read an eight-letter genetic alphabet, doubling the four letters used by all known life on Earth. Detailed imaging revealed that RNA polymerase handles synthetic DNA letters in surprisingly similar ways to natural ones. The finding brings scientists closer to building expanded genetic systems that could perform entirely new biological functions.
body.zh: 加州大学圣地亚哥分校的研究人员证明，一种关键的细胞酶可以准确读取八个字母的遗传字母表，使地球上所有已知生命使用的四个字母增加一倍。详细成像显示，RNA 聚合酶处理合成 DNA 字母的方式与天然 DNA 字母惊人地相似。这一发现使科学家们距离构建能够执行全新生物功能的扩展遗传系统又近了一步。

reflection.en: The relentless human drive to explore and understand the building blocks of life has led to a remarkable breakthrough: doubling the genetic alphabet. This expansion of our knowledge, as described in Daniel 12:4, reflects a world where 'knowledge increases.' As we unlock new biological functions, may we do so with wisdom and a deep respect for the intricate...
reflection.zh: 人类探索和理解生命基本构件的不懈驱动力带来了突破性的进展：遗传字母表翻倍。但以理书12:4说“知识增长”，这反映了我们知识的扩展。当我们解锁新的生物功能时，愿我们以智慧和对造物精妙设计的深深敬意来行事。

verse.textEn: But you, Daniel, roll up and seal the words of the scroll until the time of the end. Many will go here and there to increase knowledge.
verse.textZh: 但以理啊，你要隐藏这话，封闭这书，直到末时。必有多人来往奔跑，知识就必增长。

title.en: Quantum oscillations defy expectations in this exotic material
title.zh: 量子振荡在此奇异材料中出乎意料

summary.en: Scientists have observed unusual quantum oscillations in zirconium pentatelluride, a material exhibiting both insulating and conductive properties. Under extreme conditions of near-absolute-zero temperatures and powerful magnetic fields, electrons in this quantum material displayed unexpected behaviors, challenging...
summary.zh: 科学家在五碲化锆（一种同时具有绝缘体和导体特性的材料）中发现了异常的量子振荡现象。在接近绝对零度的低温和强大的磁场条件下，这种量子材料中的电子表现出意想不到的行为，挑战了现有的科学预期。

body.en:
A study published in Nature Communications has revealed an unusual form of quantum oscillation in a three-dimensional topological insulator. The findings show that electrons in zirconium pentatelluride (ZrTe 5 ) can behave in unexpected ways when exposed to temperatures close to absolute zero and extremely powerful magnetic fields.

The research was led by scientists from the University of São Paulo (USP) in Brazil, Los Alamos National Laboratory, the University of Washington, and other U.S. institutions. The team combined electrical transport experiments performed in magnetic fields as strong as 60 tesla and at temperatures near 0.7 kelvin (-272.45 °C) with detailed theoretical calculations.

"This work expands our understanding of electron transport in exotic phases of matter and suggests that topological insulators support the transport of not only electric charge, but also another fundamental degree of freedom: electron spin," says Julio Larrea Jiménez, a professor at USP's Physics Institute (IF) and co-founder and director of the Laboratory for Quantum Matter under Extreme Conditions (LQMEC).

Larrea served as the doctoral advisor of Cauê Kaufmann Ribeiro, the study's first author. Ribeiro carried out a large portion of the experimental work during an internship at the National High Magnetic Field Laboratory in Los Alamos, United States, supported by a FAPESP Research Internship Abroad. While there, he was co-advised by Johanna Palmstrom and Sean Thomas.

Topological insulators have an unusual combination of properties. Their interiors behave as electrical insulators, while their surfaces can conduct electricity. This behavior arises from the topology of their electronic bands, which describes broad features of the quantum structure of electronic states that are protected by crystal symmetries.

ZrTe 5 is especially valuable for studying this type of physics because it sits close to the boundary separating different topological phases. Small changes in temperature, mechanical deformation, chemical composition, or magnetic field can significantly alter its electronic behavior. That sensitivity has made ZrTe 5 an important material for investigating topological phase transitions and relativistic quasiparticles in solids.

When electrons move through a magnetic field, their possible energies no longer form a continuous range. Quantum mechanics restricts them to specific energy values known as Landau levels, named after the Soviet physicist and mathematician Lev Landau (1908-1968).

In very pure metals, these Landau levels can repeatedly pass through the Fermi level, the energy boundary between occupied and unoccupied electronic states. Each crossing can produce an oscillation in electrical resistance. These effects, known...
body.zh: 发表在《自然通讯》上的一项研究揭示了三维拓扑绝缘体中量子振荡的一种不寻常形式。研究结果表明，当暴露于接近绝对零的温度和极其强大的磁场时，五碲化锆 (ZrTe 5 ) 中的电子会以意想不到的方式表现。 这项研究由巴西圣保罗大学 (USP)、洛斯阿拉莫斯国家实验室、华盛顿大学和其他美国机构的科学家领导。该团队将在强至 60 特斯拉的磁场和接近 0.7 开尔文 (-272.45 °C) 的温度下进行的电传输实验与详细的理论计算相结合。 USP 物理研究所 (IF) 教授、极端条件下量子物质实验室 (LQMEC) 联合创始人兼主任 Julio Larrea Jiménez 表示：“这项工作扩展了我们对物质奇异相中电子传输的理解，并表明拓扑绝缘体不仅支持电荷传输，还支持另一个基本自由度：电子自旋。” Larrea 担任该研究第一作者 Cauê Kaufmann Ribeiro 的博士生导师。 Ribeiro 在美国洛斯阿拉莫斯国家高磁场实验室实习期间，在 FAPESP 海外研究实习项目的支持下，完成了大部分实验工作。在那里，他得到了约翰娜·帕姆斯特罗姆和肖恩·托马斯的共同建议。 拓扑绝缘体具有不寻常的特性组合。它们的内部表现为电绝缘体，而它们的表面可以导电。这种行为源于其电子带的拓扑结构，它描述了受晶体对称性保护的电子态量子结构的广泛特征。 ZrTe 5 对于研究此类物理特别有价值，因为它靠近分隔不同拓扑相的边界。温度、机械变形、化学成分或磁场的微小变化都可以显着改变其电子行为。这种敏感性使 ZrTe 5 成为研究固体中拓扑相变和相对论性准粒子的重要材料。 当电子穿过磁场时，它们可能的能量不再形成连续的范围。量子力学将它们限制在称为朗道能级的特定能量值，该能量值以苏联物理学家和数学家列夫·朗道（Lev Landau，1908-1968）的名字命名。 在非常纯的金属中，这些朗道能级可以反复穿过费米能级，费米能级是占据和未占据电子态之间的能量边界。每次交叉都会产生电阻振荡。这些影响，众所周知...

reflection.en: The universe, in its intricate quantum dance, continues to reveal wonders that stretch our understanding. Job 12:7 reminds us that even the smallest creatures and the most complex materials can teach us about the Creator's wisdom. As scientists probe the depths of matter, they are, in a sense, listening to the silent testimony of creation, which declares...
reflection.zh: 宇宙在其精妙的量子之舞中，不断揭示着拓展我们理解力的奇迹。约伯记12:7提醒我们，即使是最微小的生物和最复杂的物质，也能教导我们关于创造主的智慧。科学家们在探索物质深处时，在某种意义上是在倾听受造之物的无声见证，它宣告了雅伟的荣耀和智慧。

verse.textEn: But ask the animals, and they will teach you, or the birds in the sky, and they will tell you; or speak to the earth, and it will teach you, or let the fish in the sea inform you.
verse.textZh: 你且问走兽，走兽必指教你；又问空中的飞鸟，飞鸟必告诉你。或与地说话，地必指教你；海中的鱼也必向你说明。

title.en: Alcohol-related cancer deaths in US have more than doubled over three decades
title.zh: 美国酒精相关癌症死亡人数三十年翻倍

summary.en: A study reveals that alcohol-related cancer deaths in the US have more than doubled over the past three decades, with research indicating that even one drink per day can increase cancer risk, extending beyond liver cancer.
summary.zh: 一项研究发现，美国与酒精相关的癌症死亡人数在过去三十年里翻了一番多。研究表明，即使每天只饮用一杯酒也会增加患癌症的风险，并且这种影响已超出肝癌的范畴。

body.en: Study finds just one drink per day could raise risk of disease with impacts extending far beyond liver cancer Alcohol-related cancer deaths in the US have more than doubled over three decades, with new research showing that just one drink per day could raise cancer risk and that the impacts extend far beyond liver cancer. Researchers at Sylvester Comprehensive Cancer Center, part of the University of Miami Miller School of Medicine, analyzed more than three decades of Global Burden of Disease data. Their study, published in August in the Lancet Regional Health , found that annual cancer deaths attributed to alcohol climbed from 11,361 in 1990 to 23,126 in 2023. Continue reading...
body.zh: 研究发现，每天只喝一杯酒就会增加患癌症的风险，其影响远远超出肝癌范围。三十年来，美国与酒精相关的癌症死亡人数增加了一倍多，新的研究表明，每天只喝一杯酒就可能增加癌症风险，其影响范围远远超出肝癌范围。迈阿密大学米勒医学院下属的西尔维斯特综合癌症中心的研究人员分析了三十多年来的全球疾病负担数据。他们的研究发表在 8 月份的《柳叶刀地区健康》杂志上，发现每年因酒精导致的癌症死亡人数从 1990 年的 11,361 人攀升至 2023 年的 23,126 人。继续阅读...

reflection.en: This report from the US paints a sobering picture of how lifestyle choices can have profound and escalating health consequences. The doubling of alcohol-related cancer deaths over thirty years is a stark reminder of the pervasive impact of disease and the need for awareness and care. As James 5:14 encourages prayer for the sick, it also calls us to consider...
reflection.zh: 这份来自美国的研究描绘了一幅令人警醒的画面，揭示了生活方式的选择如何会带来深远且不断升级的健康后果。三十年来，与酒精相关的癌症死亡人数翻倍，这鲜明地提醒我们疾病的普遍影响，以及提高认识和关怀的必要性。正如雅各书5:14鼓励为病人祷告一样，它也促使我们反思那些可预防的痛苦根源，并在日常习惯中寻求智慧。

verse.textEn: Is anyone among you sick? Let them call the elders of the church to pray over them.
verse.textZh: 你们中间有病了的呢，他就该请教会的长老来；他们可以奉主的名用油抹他，为他祷告。

title.en: Milky Way at the dining table: Bath art show celebrates 18th-century brother and sister astronomers
title.zh: 巴斯展览突出姊妹发现——以及英格兰首位有薪女天文学家

summary.en: An exhibition in Bath showcases artworks in a Georgian townhouse where siblings William and Caroline Herschel lived and conducted groundbreaking astronomical research in the late 18th century, celebrating their pioneering spirit.
summary.zh: 在巴斯的一处乔治亚风格联排别墅中，一项新的艺术展览展示了威廉和卡罗琳·赫歇尔兄妹的生活和工作。这对兄妹在18世纪末在这里进行了一系列非凡的天文发现，展览突出了他们开创性的精神。

body.en: Exhibition opens in former home of William Herschel, who discovered Uranus, and his comet-spotting sibling Caroline From the garden of their Georgian townhouse in Bath in the late 18th century, a brother and sister made a series of extraordinary astronomical discoveries. A new art show in the house where the siblings – William and Caroline Herschel – worked and lived highlights their pioneering spirit and their domestic arrangements. Continue reading...
body.zh: 展览展出了威廉·赫歇尔 (William Herschel) 和卡罗琳·赫歇尔 (Caroline Herschel) 在 18 世纪末工作和生活的联排别墅中的艺术品。 18 世纪末，一对兄妹在巴斯 (Bath) 乔治亚风格联排别墅的花园里做出了一系列非凡的天文发现。威廉·赫歇尔和卡罗琳·赫歇尔兄妹工作和生活的房子里举办了一场新的艺术展，凸显了他们的开拓精神和家庭安排。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The exhibition in Bath celebrates the remarkable astronomical work of William and Caroline Herschel. Their dedication to their craft, carried out in their home, reminds us that all honest labor, whether in science or art, can be a form of service. Colossians 3:23 calls us to do everything with our whole heart, as if working for Yahweh Himself, bringing a...
reflection.zh: 巴斯的展览颂扬了威廉和卡罗琳·赫歇尔兄妹非凡的天文工作。他们在家中对技艺的专注，提醒我们所有诚实的工作，无论是在科学还是艺术领域，都可以是一种服务。歌罗西书3:23呼吁我们凡事都从心里做，像是为主做的，为主而做，为人的努力带来了神圣的尊严。

verse.textEn: Whatever you do, work at it with all your heart, as working for Yahweh, not for human masters.
verse.textZh: 无论做什么，都要从心里做，像是给主做的，不是给人做的。

title.en: Briefing Chat: How 1,000 pairs of buried underpants helped measure soil health
title.zh: 简报聊天：一千条埋藏的内裤如何帮助测量土壤健康

summary.en: Nature staff discuss the winners of the 2026 Ig Nobel prizes, including a study using buried underpants to assess soil health, and the potential first glimpse of dark matter from an isolated energy flash.
summary.zh: 《自然》杂志的员工讨论了2026年搞笑诺贝尔奖的获奖者，其中包括一项使用埋藏的内裤来评估土壤健康的研究，以及一次孤立的能量闪光可能带来的暗物质的首次瞥见。

reflection.en: The Ig Nobel prizes often celebrate research that is both humorous and insightful, much like this study using underpants to gauge soil health. It reminds us that wisdom and understanding can be found in unexpected places, even in the decay of fabric, reflecting the ancient truth that creation itself speaks of its Maker's wisdom....
reflection.zh: 搞笑诺贝尔奖常常表彰既幽默又有见地的研究，就像这项用内裤来衡量土壤健康的研究一样。它提醒我们，智慧和理解可以在意想不到的地方找到，甚至在织物的腐烂中，这反映了古老的真理：创造本身就诉说着其创造者的智慧。...

verse.textEn: But ask the animals, and they will teach you, or the birds in the sky, and they will tell you; or speak to the earth, and it will teach you, or let the fish in the sea inform you.
verse.textZh: 你且问走兽，走兽必指教你；又问空中的飞鸟，飞鸟必告诉你。或与地说话，地必指教你；海中的鱼也必向你说明。

title.en: Super-precise optical clocks in four nations tick in harmony
title.zh: 四国超精密光钟同步滴答作响

summary.en: Comparison using signals sent over fibre-optic cable tests agreement between seven devices spread across Europe.
summary.zh: 通过光纤信号传输进行比对，检验了分布在欧洲各地的七台设备之间的一致性。

reflection.en: The pursuit of precision in science, as seen in the synchronized optical clocks, echoes the ancient wisdom found in observing the created world. The intricate workings of the universe, from the smallest particles to the grandest celestial bodies, reveal the order and intelligence of the Creator. This scientific endeavor, by testing the harmony of these...
reflection.zh: 科学中对精度的追求，正如同步光钟所展示的那样，呼应了观察受造世界所蕴含的古老智慧。宇宙的精密运作，从最小的粒子到最宏伟的天体，都揭示了造物主的秩序和智慧。这项科学探索通过检验这些时钟的和谐性，提醒我们，理解周围的世界是通往更深洞察的途径。

verse.textEn: But ask the animals, and they will teach you, or the birds in the sky, and they will tell you; or speak to the earth, and it will teach you, or let the fish in the sea inform you.
verse.textZh: 你且问走兽，走兽必指教你；又问空中的飞鸟，飞鸟必告诉你。或与地说话，地必指教你；海中的鱼也必向你说明。

title.en: Technology Desk
title.zh: 科技前沿

strap.en: Technology shaping how we live, work, and think.
strap.zh: 正在改变生活、工作与思考方式的科技动态。

title.en: ‘We’re plausibly close to crossing the line’: are warnings of uncontrollable AI coming true?
title.zh: “我们可能已接近越过那条线”：关于无法控制的人工智能的警告正在成真吗？

summary.en: A series of significant safety incidents have amplified concerns regarding the power and inscrutability of the most advanced AI models. Analogies used by an AI governance expert depict humanity at a critical juncture, akin to early nuclear physicists before their first chain reaction, facing both peril and potential.
summary.zh: 一系列严重的事故加剧了人们对最先进人工智能模型的力量和不可穿透性的担忧。一位人工智能治理专家的类比描绘了人类正处于一个危险但充满潜力的时刻，类似于早期核物理学家在首次链式反应之前的情景。

body.en: A spate of serious safety incidents have increased fears about the power and impenetrability of the most advanced models Picture humanity in a boat being swept down a raging river, praying there is no Niagara Falls ahead. Or imagine standing with the pioneering physicists in 1942 before they triggered the first self-sustaining nuclear fission chain reaction beneath a Chicago stadium. These were two of the analogies used this week by Prof Robert Trager, an expert in the nascent field of AI governance, to describe the perilous but potential-filled moment the world stands at with accelerating artificial intelligence. Continue reading...
body.zh: 一连串严重的安全事件增加了人们对最先进模型的力量和不可穿透性的担忧。想象一下，人类乘坐一艘船被冲进汹涌的河流，祈祷前面没有尼亚加拉大瀑布。或者想象一下 1942 年，在物理学家先驱们在芝加哥体育场下方引发第一个自持核裂变链式反应之前，您与他们站在一起。这是人工智能治理新兴领域的专家罗伯特·特拉格教授本周使用的两个类比，用来描述世界正面临人工智能加速发展的危险但充满潜力的时刻。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The rapid advancement of AI, described as a boat swept towards an unknown precipice, evokes the ancient story of Babel. Humanity's ambition to build towers reaching the heavens, without sufficient wisdom or humility, can lead to unforeseen consequences. We are called to pursue knowledge and innovation, but always with a sober awareness of our limits and a...
reflection.zh: 人工智能的飞速发展，被比作一艘驶向未知深渊的船，令人联想到古代巴别塔的故事。人类渴望建造通天高塔的雄心，若缺乏足够的智慧和谦卑，可能导致无法预料的后果。我们被呼召去追求知识和创新，但必须时刻警醒于自身的局限，并深深依赖于神的指引。

verse.textEn: Yahweh said, 'If as one people speaking the same language they have begun to do this, then nothing they plan to do will be impossible for them.'
verse.textZh: 雅伟说：「看哪，他们成为一样的人民，都是一样的言语，如今既做起这事来，以后他们所要做的事就没有不成就的了。」

title.en: Food delivery riders call on platforms to open up AI ‘black box’ they say has cut pay
title.zh: 外卖骑手呼吁平台公开AI“黑箱”，称其已削减工资

summary.en: Workers who blame algorithms for lowering their earnings are getting help from academics to find out how the system works. Gig economy workers are urging delivery platforms to open up the “black box” of computer-driven algorithms that determine the jobs they are offered and how much they are paid, blaming increased...
summary.zh: 工人们指责算法降低了他们的收入，并正在寻求学者的帮助来了解该系统的工作原理。零工经济工人敦促外卖平台公开决定他们获得工作机会以及报酬的计算机驱动算法的“黑箱”，并将工资降低归咎于人工智能使用量的增加。爱丁堡的一群外卖骑手表示，在Deliveroo、Uber Eats和Just...

body.en: Workers who blame algorithms for lowering their earnings are getting help from academics to find out how the system works Gig economy workers are urging delivery platforms to open up the “black box” of computer-driven algorithms that determine the jobs they are offered and how much they are paid, blaming increased use of AI for lowering wages. A group of food delivery riders in Edinburgh say their rates of pay have fallen and their working conditions have deteriorated at the same time as Deliveroo, Uber Eats and Just Eat, the three dominant gig economy platforms in the UK and Ireland, have increased their use of automation. Continue reading...
body.zh: 那些指责算法降低了收入的工人正在寻求学术界的帮助，以了解该系统是如何运作的。零工经济工人正在敦促交付平台打开计算机驱动算法的“黑匣子”，这些算法决定了他们提供的工作和报酬，他们将降低工资归咎于人工智能的使用增加。爱丁堡的一群送餐骑手表示，在英国和爱尔兰三大主要零工经济平台 Deliveroo、Uber Eats 和 Just Eat 增加自动化使用的同时，他们的工资下降了，工作条件也恶化了。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The pursuit of efficiency through AI can sometimes obscure the human cost. When algorithms dictate pay and working conditions, workers feel unheard and unfairly treated, as these food delivery riders in Edinburgh describe. The Bible speaks directly to this, with James warning that the cries of the unpaid or underpaid workers ascend to heaven.
reflection.zh: 通过人工智能追求效率有时会掩盖其对人类造成的代价。当算法决定薪酬和工作条件时，工人会感到被忽视和不公平对待，正如爱丁堡的外卖骑手们所描述的那样。圣经直接谈到了这一点，雅各书警告说，被拖欠或支付不足的工人的哀求会直达天上。

verse.textEn: Look! The wages you failed to pay the workers who mowed your fields are crying out against you. The cries of the harvesters have reached the ears of Yahweh Almighty.
verse.textZh: 工人给你们收割庄稼，你们亏欠他们的工钱，这工钱有声音呼叫，并且那收割之人的冤声已经入了万军之主的耳了。
